description_en: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time.  If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after %AbilityDuration% seconds.
notes_zh: 每0.5秒造成一次伤害。

subject: ancient_apparition_ice_vortex
description_zh: 创造一个寒冰能量的漩涡，对范围内敌人造成伤害和减速，并增加他们受到的魔法伤害。
description_en: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.
notes_zh: 提供放置地点的小片视野。

subject: ancient_apparition_chilling_touch
description_zh: 使自己的普通攻击附带距离提升，高额魔法伤害和减速效果。
description_en: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.

scepter.zh: 移除了冷却时间。
scepter.en: Removes cooldown.

subject: ancient_apparition_bone_chill
description_zh: 每当远古冰魄通过他的技能对敌人造成魔法伤害，敌人就会减速一段时间。如果目标是英雄，力量还会降低。多个本效果会叠加，并且持续时间相互独立。
description_en: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.

scepter.zh: 基础力量降低提升%tooltip_scepter_bonus%。
scepter.en: Increases Base Strength Reduction by %tooltip_scepter_bonus%.

subject: ancient_apparition_ice_blast
description_zh: 向地图的任意位置发出爆炸冰球，在冰球飞行时再次施放此技能将使其停下，使所在区域产生毁灭性的冰爆。冰球飞行的距离越长，冰爆影响的范围也将越大。冰爆范围内的所有敌方单位将马上受到大量伤害，而处于冰球飞行路径上的敌方英雄将与冰爆范围内的敌方英雄一同受到寒霜诅咒的作用，持续受到小幅伤害，同时无法恢复生命值。在此期间如果生命值低于一定百分比，该英雄将立刻死亡。
description_en: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
notes_zh: 施放后本技能替换为释放，将使指向球停在目标区域。
作用范围的大小是%radius_min% + %radius_grow%*指向球的飞行时间，上限为%radius_max%。
击杀目标的英雄由触发即死的伤害来源决定。
斩杀效果对幻象无效。
寒霜诅咒的负面状态无法被驱散，包括身处泉水附近，但魂断、时光倒流和超新星除外。

shard.zh: 冻结击中的敌人，持续时间为当前等级寒霜之足眩晕时间的%cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%%。
shard.en: Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for %cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%% of the duration.

subject: ursa_earthshock
description_zh: 熊战士向前跳跃%hop_distance%距离并猛击地面带来强烈的冲击，对附近范围内的所有敌方单位造成伤害并减速%abilityduration%秒。
description_en: Ursa leaps forward %hop_distance% units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for %abilityduration% seconds.

shard.zh: 震撼大地对击中的敌人施加%fury_swipe_stacks_on_hit%层怒意狂击。
shard.en: Earthshock applies %fury_swipe_stacks_on_hit% Fury Swipes to enemies hit.

subject: ursa_overpower
description_zh: 乌尔萨在战斗中运用他的技艺，提升了接下来几次攻击的攻击速度，同时还获得了减速抗性。
description_en: Using his skill in combat, Ursa gains increased attack speed and slow resistance for a number of subsequent attacks.
notes_zh: 攻击丢失还是会消耗超强力量的攻击次数。

subject: ursa_fury_swipes
description_zh: 熊战士的利爪深深地撕裂敌人的伤口，对同一敌人连续攻击将造成更多伤害。如果同一个目标在%bonus_reset_time%秒内不受攻击，将失去额外伤害加成。
description_en: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage.  If the same target is not attacked after %bonus_reset_time% seconds, the bonus damage is lost.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法施加新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的状态失效。

subject: ursa_maul
description_zh: 熊战士获得攻击力加成，数值为当前生命值的一定百分比。
description_en: Ursa gains bonus damage equal to a percentage of his Current HP.

subject: ursa_enrage
description_zh:
乌尔萨进入狂怒状态，承受的伤害降低并获得状态抗性。施放时将移除所受的负面效果。

驱散类型：强驱散
description_en:
Ursa goes into a frenzy, providing damage reduction and status resistance. Removes any existing debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

scepter.zh: 减少冷却时间，而且熊战士可以在被控制的状态下使用激怒。
scepter.en: Reduces cooldown and allows Ursa to use Enrage while disabled.

subject: spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness
description_zh: 裂魂人盯紧一个敌方单位，开始无视一切物体的冲刺，起始为%min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%%额外移速，%windup_time%秒后达到最大速度。途中经过的所有敌方单位和目标单位都将受到巨力重击。如果目标单位在到达前阵亡，裂魂人将他的目标改为原路径上最近的一个敌方单位。
description_en: Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s.All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash.  If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
notes_zh: 裂魂人在冲刺过程中能穿过树木，悬崖和任何单位。
冲刺指示特效仅对队友可见。
裂魂人将获得并共享目标的视野。

subject: spirit_breaker_bulldoze
description_zh: 裂魂人获得移动速度和状态抗性加成，在敌人之间横冲直撞。可以在冲刺期间使用。
description_en: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.

subject: spirit_breaker_greater_bash
description_zh: 攻击时有一定概率眩晕并击退敌方单位。重击的伤害值为移动速度的一定百分比。
description_en: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
notes_zh: 不与碎颅锤叠加。
破坏会使攻击触发巨力重击失效。暗影冲刺或幽冥一击还是会施加巨力重击。

scepter.zh: 击退效果提升。如果击退的敌人又撞到了一个敌人，这个敌人也会被重击（非英雄单位只受到%cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%%伤害），并且原目标再次受到%cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%%的巨力重击伤害。
scepter.en: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive %cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%% damage), and the original target takes %cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%% of Greater Bash's damage again.

subject: spirit_breaker_planar_pocket
description_zh: 巴拉森获得魔法抗性，并扭曲选定英雄附近的现实，使敌方英雄施放的任意指向性技能转向裂魂人。可以对友方和敌方英雄施放，但是只有裂魂人的敌人施放的技能才会转向。
description_en: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.
notes_zh: 如果裂魂人和目标之间的距离超过%break_distance%，位面空洞效果会停止。

subject: spirit_breaker_bull_rush
description_zh: 裂魂人只要眩晕敌人就会获得移动速度加成。来自多个眩晕的效果会叠加，并且拥有独立的持续时间。暗影冲刺期间持续时间会暂停。
description_en: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.
notes_zh: 神行太保的加成状态使裂魂人能够突破移动速度上限。

subject: spirit_breaker_nether_strike
description_zh: 裂魂人遁入幽冥领域，从不幸的目标身旁再次出现，发动当前等级的巨力重击并造成额外伤害。击退距离为平常的两倍。
description_en: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.
notes_zh: 裂魂人将在目标身后出现并发动巨力重击。

scepter.zh: 大幅提升击退效果。
scepter.en: Greatly increases knockback.

subject: gyrocopter_rocket_barrage
description_zh: 向矮人直升机附近一定范围内的敌方单位齐射导弹。持续%barrage_duration%秒。
description_en: Launches a salvo of rockets at nearby enemy units in a radius around the Gyrocopter. Lasts %barrage_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 火箭弹幕不能伤害矮人直升机视野之外的单位。
追踪导弹发射的火箭弹幕不会触发加力燃烧器。

subject: gyrocopter_homing_missile
description_zh: 发射一枚会自动定位目标单位的追踪导弹。导弹发射后持续增加飞行速度，击中目标时造成伤害及眩晕。敌方单位可在导弹接近前将其击落。
description_en: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.
notes_zh: 防御塔对导弹造成半额伤害。
准星效果仅对队友可见。
导弹会跟随并击中隐身单位。

shard.zh: 追踪导弹现在从施放%shard_delay%秒后开始不断发射%shard_radius%作用范围的火箭弹幕。火箭弹幕优先以追踪导弹的目标为目标。
shard.en: Homing Missiles now constantly fires the current level of Rocket Barrage in a %shard_radius% area of effect after %shard_delay% second of being cast. This Rocket Barrage prioritizes the Homing Missile target.

subject: gyrocopter_flak_cannon
description_zh: 矮人直升机的攻击会击中目标周围一定范围内的所有敌人，持续一定次数的攻击。只有主要目标会受到致命一击等攻击特效。持续%abilityduration%秒或攻击次数耗尽。
description_en: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks.  Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds or until the attacks are used.
notes_zh: 对主目标的攻击距离没有改变。

subject: gyrocopter_afterburner
name_zh: 矮人直升机·加力燃烧器
description_zh: 矮人直升机通过攻击或技能对敌人造成伤害后，在短时间内获得移动速度提升。
description_en: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.

subject: gyrocopter_side_gunner_spawn_ability
description_zh: 矮人直升机获得侧翼机枪，每%sidegunner_fire_rate%秒对矮人直升机附近%AbilityCastRange%范围内的敌方单位发动攻击。优先攻击范围内最远的单位。
description_en: Gyrocopter gains a Side Gunner that attacks enemy units in a %AbilityCastRange% unit radius every %sidegunner_fire_rate%s with his attack. Prioritizes furthest unit away within its range.
notes_zh: 即使矮人直升机被控制，侧翼机枪也能攻击。

subject: gyrocopter_call_down
description_zh: 召唤%total_strikes%波防空导弹，对目标区域内的敌方单位造成减速和伤害。每次打击与上一次间隔%strike_separation%距离。
description_en: Call down %total_strikes% aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area. Each strike is %strike_separation% distance from the previous one.
notes_zh: 视觉指示范围仅对队友可见。

subject: alchemist_acid_spray
description_zh: 向目标区域喷洒高压酸雾。穿过受污染地带的敌人每秒会受到物理伤害，同时护甲被削弱。
description_en: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.

subject: alchemist_unstable_concoction
name_zh: 炼金术士·不稳定化合物
description_zh: 炼金术士调制一瓶不稳定的化合物，投向敌方英雄，对爆炸点周边范围的单位造成伤害并眩晕。调制的时间越久，伤害越大，眩晕时间也越长。炼金术士在调制期间获得移动速度加成。调制%brew_time%秒后达到最大伤害量和最长眩晕时间。然而，若%brew_explosion%秒后未扔出药剂，则会在炼金术士自己手中爆炸。
description_en: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After %brew_time% seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after %brew_explosion% seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.
notes_zh: 摇制开始后，本技能替换为投掷不稳定化合物。炼金术士在摇制期间可以像平常一样移动和攻击。
炼金术士的头顶会有倒计时，提示剩余的摇制时间。倒计时对敌人可见。
可以用此技能将自己反补。
不稳定化合物无法被躲避，并且不稳定化合物被掷出后会停止调制。
不稳定化合物的爆炸会对英雄和非英雄单位造成伤害。

subject: alchemist_corrosive_weaponry
description_zh:
炼金术士使他的武器浸满强酸，对击中的敌人施加可叠加的减速和基础攻击力降低效果。

每次攻击施加%stacks_per_attack%层叠加效果。不稳定化合物每调制1秒施加%one_tooltip%层叠加效果。
description_en:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply %stacks_per_attack% stacks. Unstable Concoction applies %one_tooltip% stack per second of brew time.

subject: alchemist_berserk_potion
description_zh: 炼金术士向友军目标扔出一瓶药剂，施加弱驱散效果，并提供攻击速度、移动速度和生命恢复。驱散类型：弱驱散
description_en: Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

subject: alchemist_goblins_greed
description_zh: 炼金术士将敌人的尸体和赏金神符转化成额外的金币。炼金术士每杀死一个单位，就能获得基础额外金钱和附加额外金钱。如果炼金术士在接下来%duration%秒内又杀死了一个单位，获得了黄金，那么他所获得的附加额外金钱将有一定幅度的增加。另外，赏金神符将提供成倍金钱。
description_en: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next %duration% seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.

scepter.zh: 炼金术士熔铸阿哈利姆神杖并让一位友方英雄获得所有神杖升级效果。炼金术士每送出一把神杖都将获得%scepter_bonus_damage%点攻击力加成，贪魔的贪婪的基础和最高金钱增加%bonus_gold_per_scepter%。
scepter.en: Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and %bonus_gold_per_scepter% additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.

subject: alchemist_chemical_rage
description_zh:
炼金术士诱发他的食人魔同伴进入化学狂暴，降低攻击间隔，提高移动速度和生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
description_en:
Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 拥有%transformation_time%秒的变身时间，可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道以及眩晕技能。

subject: invoker_quas
description_zh: 允许祈求者掌控冰元素。每个活跃的冰元素会让祈求者获得生命恢复加成。每级冰被动提供额外力量。
description_en: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active Quas instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of Quas.
notes_zh: 祈求者最多只有3个元素。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。

scepter.zh: 提供%scepter_bonus_levels%级当前和最高等级。
scepter.en: Grants %scepter_bonus_levels% current and max level.

subject: invoker_wex
description_zh: 允许祈求者掌控雷元素。每个活跃的雷元素会让祈求者获得移动和攻击速度加成。每级雷被动提供额外敏捷。
description_en: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active Wex instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of Wex.
notes_zh: 祈求者最多只有3个球。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。

scepter.zh: 提供%scepter_bonus_levels%级当前和最高等级。
scepter.en: Grants %scepter_bonus_levels% current and max level.

subject: invoker_exort
description_zh: 允许祈求者掌控火元素。每个活跃的火元素会让祈求者获得攻击力加成。每级火被动提供额外智力。
description_en: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active Exort instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of Exort.
notes_zh: 祈求者最多只有3个球。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。

scepter.zh: 提供%scepter_bonus_levels%级当前和最高等级。
scepter.en: Grants %scepter_bonus_levels% current and max level.

subject: invoker_invoke
description_zh: 将当前掌握的元素精华融合，创造出新的法术供祈求者施放。每个元素球的等级都会减少%cooldown_reduction_per_orb%秒元素祈唤的冷却时间。祈求者达到%first_ability_level%、%second_ability_level%和%third_ability_level%时会分别额外获得一点技能点。祈求者高深的魔法学识让他可以从多个阿哈利姆神杖和魔晶升级效果中进行选择。物品必须先激活才能生效，而且选择后无法更改。点击帮助按钮可查看所有可用法术。
description_en: Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_orb% seconds for each orb level.  Invoker gains a bonus ability point for his orbs at levels %first_ability_level%, %second_ability_level%, and %third_ability_level%.Invoker's vast knowledge of magic allows him to choose from Multiple Aghanim's Scepter and Shard options.  The items must be activated before they can be used, and cannot be changed after they are chosen. Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.
notes_zh: 生成的技能与三个球的排列顺序无关。
只是交换现有技能的位置并不会消耗魔法，也不会触发元素祈唤的冷却。
元素祈唤不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。

subject: invoker_cold_snap
description_zh: 祈求者将敌人的热量抽空，将其降到绝对零度，持续时间取决于冰元素等级。敌人将受到伤害并被短暂冻结，后续攻击会使敌人再次冻结并造成额外伤害。被冻结的频率固定，但是冻结的冷却时间将会随着冰元素等级提高而缩短。
description_en: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of Quas. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of Quas.
notes_zh: 只有%damage_trigger%点以上的实际伤害才能触发急速冷却。

subject: invoker_ghost_walk
description_zh: 祈求者操纵冰电之力围绕自身，使自己隐形并且获得生命和魔法恢复。各种元素的不平衡导致附近敌人的移动速度被减缓，减速效果取决于冰元素的等级，并使祈求者自身移动速度减缓，减速效果与雷元素等级成反比。
description_en: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of Wex.
notes_zh: 减速效果对减益免疫状态下的单位无效。

shard.zh: 现在幽灵漫步还会对范围内的敌方英雄施加寒冰之墙的每秒伤害。
shard.en: Ghost Walk now also applies the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemy heroes in its area of effect.

subject: invoker_tornado
description_zh:
释放出一道快速移动的飓风，将路径上的敌方单位卷起，使其在空中无助地漂浮一段时间，然后落地受死。最大距离取决于雷元素等级。滞空时间取决于冰元素等级。落地伤害取决于雷元素的等级。

驱散类型：弱驱散
description_en:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of Wex. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of Quas. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in Wex.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 被强袭飓风吹起时单位处于无敌状态，落地时受到伤害。

scepter.zh: 强袭飓风会沿其路径产生气旋。气旋在飓风的持续时间内会一直持续，并且飓风消失后还会基于冰的等级额外持续数秒。气旋每%twister_tick_rate%秒在%twister_radius%范围内基于雷的等级造成伤害。（对非英雄单位造成半额伤害。）
scepter.en: Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on Quas, dealing damage based on Wex in a %twister_radius% radius every %twister_tick_rate% seconds. (half damage to creeps.)

subject: invoker_emp
description_zh: 祈求者在指定位置召唤出一道强力的自爆电磁脉冲，%delay%秒后将自动爆炸。爆炸将覆盖一定区域，并根据雷元素的等级损毁敌方的魔法值。对敌方英雄造成损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。祈求者将获得%self_mana_restore_pct%%%损毁的魔法。
description_en: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of Wex. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains %self_mana_restore_pct%%% of the mana drained.
notes_zh: 对被吹起的单位（强袭飓风或Eul的神圣法杖）无效。

shard.zh: 提升电磁脉冲燃烧魔法的伤害系数，并且将敌方单位以每秒%drag_speed%距离的速度向电磁脉冲的中心牵引。
shard.en: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %drag_speed% units per second.

subject: invoker_alacrity
description_zh: 祈求者给友方单位灌注强大的能量，提高其攻击速度和攻击力。攻击速度提升程度取决于雷元素等级，攻击力提升取决于火元素等级。
description_en: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of Wex and their damage based on the level of Exort.

subject: invoker_chaos_meteor
description_zh: 祈求者从太空中召唤一枚燃烧的流星打击指定位置。流星着陆后会向前滚动一段距离，每隔一段时间撞击一次作用范围内的敌人，造成基于火元素等级的撞击伤害，滚动距离取决于雷元素的等级。每被撞击一次都将持续受到烧灼伤害，烧灼伤害取决于火元素的等级。
description_en: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of Exort, and rolling further based on the level of Wex. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of Exort.
notes_zh: 每个敌方单位受到撞击伤害的间隔为%damage_interval%秒，后续较低的烧灼伤害持续%burn_duration%秒。
陨石移动的速度为%travel_speed%。

subject: invoker_sun_strike
description_zh: 向目标区域释放毁灭性的阳炎之光能量，一旦能量着陆，将对区域内的敌人进行灼烧。伤害取决于火元素等级，区域内敌人将平摊所有伤害。
description_en: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of Exort, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
notes_zh: 施放后立即获得目标区域的视野。
祈求者使用阳炎冲击击杀英雄后，即使不在经验范围内也能获得经验。

scepter.zh: 双击阳炎冲击会发动毁天灭地。施放后阳炎冲击的冷却时间为%cataclysm_cooldown%秒。每个敌方英雄附近%cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range%范围内产生%cataclysm_count%个可见的阳炎冲击，每个都具有%cataclysm_damage_pct%%%伤害。
scepter.en: Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a %cataclysm_cooldown% second cooldown. Creates %cataclysm_count% visible %cataclysm_damage_pct%%% damage Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.

shard.zh: 阳炎冲击对敌方英雄造成伤害时，该地点会产生当前等级的熔炉精灵。
shard.en: If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.

subject: invoker_forge_spirit
description_zh: 祈求者融合火之灼热和冰之坚毅，创造出熔炉精灵。熔炉精灵的攻击力和护甲取决于火元素的等级，攻击距离、持续时间和生命值取决于冰元素的等级。元素的灼热攻击能够熔化敌方英雄的护甲。熔炉精灵的产生数量取决于冰元素和火元素中等级较低的元素。
description_en: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of Exort while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of Quas. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of Quas and Exort.
notes_zh: 施放此技能后原有的熔炉精灵将会死亡。

subject: invoker_ice_wall
description_zh: 在祈求者前方创造一堵寒冰之墙，持续时间取决于冰元素的等级。冰霜之墙放射出的寒冰之气将对敌方单位造成减速和伤害，减速效果取决于冰元素的等级，每秒伤害取决于火元素的等级。
description_en: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of Quas. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas and deals damage each second based on the level of Exort.

scepter.zh: 寒冰之墙变成浮冰，以矢量为目标。经过短暂延迟后，浮冰出现再产生一道%wall_width%宽度的寒冰之墙。在浮冰内停留超过%root_delay%秒的敌方英雄会基于冰的等级被缠绕并受到魔法伤害。
scepter.en: Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a %wall_width% width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than %root_delay% seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on Quas.

subject: invoker_deafening_blast
description_zh: 祈求者在自己前方释放出超强的声波，对所有敌方单位造成伤害，伤害量取决于火元素的等级。声波的绝对冲击能够将敌方单位击退，击退时间取决于冰元素的等级，同时让他们无法进行攻击，禁止攻击时间取决于雷元素的等级。
description_en: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of Exort. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of Quas, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of Wex.

subject: silencer_curse_of_the_silent
description_zh: 诅咒目标区域，造成伤害并使敌人持续受到伤害，并且移动速度被减缓。期间受到作用的英雄一旦施放魔法，持续时间就会延长。目标被沉默时不计入负面效果的持续时间。
description_en: Curses the target area, dealing damage and causing enemies to take damage over time and slowing their movement speed.Anytime affected enemies cast a spell, the duration is increased. The duration is paused as long as the target is silenced.
notes_zh: 非英雄单位也会受到作用。

subject: silencer_glaives_of_wisdom
description_zh: 沉默术士用他的智慧强化刀刃，每次攻击窃取目标的智力，并造成基于他智力值的额外伤害。
description_en: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.

shard.zh: 使智慧之刃向%bounce_range% 范围内的随机敌人弹射%bounce_count%次，并提升智力窃取。
shard.en: Causes Glaives of Wisdom to bounce %bounce_count% time to a random enemy within %bounce_range% range and increases intelligence steal.

subject: silencer_last_word
description_zh: 向目标施加魔咒，提供目标的视野，并且只要目标施放技能或魔咒消失，目标就会受到伤害并被沉默。根据沉默术士和目标的智力差还将造成额外伤害。
description_en: Enchants a target, providing vision of them and causing them to be damaged and silenced if they cast a spell or if the enchantment timer expires. Deals extra damage based on the difference in intelligence between Silencer and the target.
notes_zh: 持续施法类技能在英雄结束施法后触发此技能的效果。

subject: silencer_brain_drain
description_zh: 沉默术士对被沉默的目标造成更多伤害，受到来自他们的伤害减少。只要敌方英雄在沉默术士附近%permanent_int_steal_range%范围内阵亡或者死亡时带有沉默术士的负面效果，沉默术士都会永久窃取其%permanent_int_steal_amount%点智力。如果敌方英雄阵亡时被沉默，将额外窃取%silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount%点智力。
description_en: Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.If an enemy Hero dies within %permanent_int_steal_range% range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals %permanent_int_steal_amount% Intelligence from them.  If the victim was silenced, steal an extra %silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount% Intelligence.

subject: silencer_global_silence
description_zh: 沉默术士停止一切声音，阻止地图上所有敌方英雄和单位施法。
description_en: Silencer stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.
notes_zh: 沉默效果对隐身和减益免疫单位有效，但是期间获得减益免疫状态将移除该效果。
来自阿哈利姆神杖升级全领域静默的多个奥术诅咒不会叠加。

scepter.zh: 全领域静默在全领域静默的持续时间内对英雄施加奥术诅咒。
scepter.en: Global Silence applies Arcane Curse to heroes for the duration of Global Silence.

subject: obsidian_destroyer_arcane_orb
description_zh: 殁境神蚀者的攻击附带基于剩余魔法值的额外纯粹伤害。
description_en: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.
notes_zh: 根据使用此技能后的魔法值计算附加伤害。

subject: obsidian_destroyer_astral_imprisonment
description_zh: 窃取目标最大魔法值的一定百分比，将其禁锢在星体中。被隐藏的英雄处于无敌和无法行动状态。禁锢结束时，对目标造成伤害。
description_en: Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.
notes_zh: 被禁锢的单位依然能受到神智之蚀的作用。
最大魔法值窃取效果不会提升殁境神蚀者的当前魔法值，也不会直接减少目标的当前魔法值。

shard.zh: 星体禁锢现在会造成范围伤害。另外友军在星体禁锢期间能以%allied_movement_speed_pct%%%移动速度进行移动（他们为可见状态，但无法成为目标，也不能执行其他任何动作）。
shard.en: Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at %allied_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).

subject: obsidian_destroyer_objurgation
description_zh: 提升殁境神蚀者的最大魔法值。施放后，殁境神蚀者获得全伤害护盾，数值为固定值 + 最大魔法值的一定百分比。
description_en: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.

scepter.zh: 提升最大魔法值转为护盾的比例。阻止让殁境神蚀者的血量低于%automatic_trigger_threshold%%%的伤害。阻止生效时，殁境神蚀者获得一次强驱散，和不可驱散的责难效果。这个效果每%automatic_trigger_cd%秒只能触发一次。
scepter.en: Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below %automatic_trigger_threshold%%% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every %automatic_trigger_cd% seconds.

subject: obsidian_destroyer_equilibrium
description_zh: 被动拥有一定几率在施放技能时回复最大魔法值的一定百分比。通过攻击特效的技能回复的魔法会减少。
description_en: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of your max mana each time you cast an ability. Restores less mana from spells that modify attacks.

subject: obsidian_destroyer_sanity_eclipse
description_zh: 释放出一道神智冲击波，伤害数值基于自身与目标的最大魔法值之差。神智之蚀可以作用于星体禁锢中的单位。
description_en: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your max mana and the target's max mana. Sanity's Eclipse can hit units trapped by Astral Imprisonment.

subject: lycan_summon_wolves
description_zh: 召唤%wolf_count%头精灵狼为狼人战斗。3级精灵狼获得永久隐身，4级精灵狼获得致残技能，20%几率使目标残废，造成每秒8点伤害，并失去60攻击速度，持续4秒。
description_en: Summons %wolf_count% wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
notes_zh: 使用此技能后原来的狼群将会死亡。

shard.zh: 召唤的精灵狼的数量提升。所有召唤的精灵狼获得健步如飞技能，这个主动技能使精灵狼获得相位移动，闪避，移动速度和攻击速度。
shard.en: Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.

subject: lycan_howl
description_zh: 使敌人感到害怕，狼人和精灵狼周围%radius%范围内所有敌人的护甲和攻击力降低。夜晚期间嗥叫的护甲和攻击力降低效果为全地图生效。
description_en: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within %radius% range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.

subject: lycan_feral_impulse
description_zh: 提升狼人和所有他控制的单位的生命恢复和攻击力。
description_en: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.

subject: lycan_wolf_bite
description_zh: 狼人撕咬友方英雄或类英雄单位，使其获得变身效果。自身和目标都获得%lifesteal_percent%%%吸血效果，并且双方距离只要不超过%lifesteal_range%就能共用吸血效果。
description_en: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain %lifesteal_percent%%% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within %lifesteal_range% range of each other.
notes_zh: 饿狼撕咬的冷却时间与变身的当前等级相同。

subject: lycan_apex_predator
description_zh: 狼人和他控制的单位对中立生物造成额外伤害。
description_en: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.

subject: lycan_shapeshift
description_zh: 狼人展现出他的凶狼形态，获得致命一击的能力，并且提升夜间视野。在变身期间，狼人达到超高移动速度，并且不能被减速。移动速度和致命一击也会施加给狼人控制下的所有单位。
description_en: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed.  Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.
notes_zh: 狼人的移动速度不会受到妖术的影响。

subject: brewmaster_thunder_clap
description_zh: 猛击地面，造成伤害并降低附近敌方单位的移动速度和攻击速度。
description_en: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.

subject: brewmaster_cinder_brew
description_zh: 向敌人扔出一个酒桶，对沿途的敌人造成伤害，并在目标地点溅出酒液。路径上和溅酒点的敌人会浸满余烬佳酿，并且被减速。受到魔法或纯粹伤害后还将被点燃。点燃时持续时间增加%extra_duration%秒，并且受到持续伤害。
description_en: Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed.  If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by %extra_duration%s and causing them to take damage over time.

subject: brewmaster_drunken_brawler
description_zh: 酒仙可以根据操控的元素来切换拳法。每当酒仙施放技能，他都会进入浸酒状态，拳法的威力提升%brewed_up_bonus%%%，持续%brewed_up_duration%秒。如果他在浸酒状态下又施放了技能，持续时间会延长%brewed_up_duration_extend%秒。浸酒状态结束后，他会进入大醉状态，%hangover_time%秒内无法再次进入浸酒状态。大地拳法 - 获得护甲和魔法抗性加成。狂风拳法 - 获得闪避和移动速度加成。烈火拳法 - 获得攻击速度加成，并且拥有几率造成致命一击伤害。
description_en: Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by %brewed_up_bonus%%% for %brewed_up_duration%s.  If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by %brewed_up_duration_extend%s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for %hangover_time%s.Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.
notes_zh: 与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。

subject: brewmaster_liquid_courage
description_zh: 当酒仙的生命值低于%min_health_threshold%%%，他就会获得状态抗性加成，而且他的移动速度每%speed_toggle_time%秒都会在加速和减速之间改变。血量越低，效果越强，从0开始到%max_health_threshold%%%生命值时达到最大数值。
description_en: When Brewmaster drops below %min_health_threshold%%% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every %speed_toggle_time%s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at %max_health_threshold%%% Health.

shard.zh: 向队友丢出一杯烈酒，或自己一饮而尽，获得壮胆酒的最大效果，并且还会获得每秒%max_hp_regen%%%最大生命值的回复。持续%drink_duration%秒。
shard.en: Toss a strong drink to a teammate or drink it yourself, activating the maximum power effect of Liquid Courage and granting %max_hp_regen%%% Max HP Regen per second.Lasts %drink_duration% seconds.

subject: brewmaster_primal_split
description_zh: 酒仙分裂成元素，产生3个各有所长的战士，生存能力极强，每个都拥有独特技能。只要其中任何一个在召唤时间结束后存活下来，酒仙就能重生。每个战士都会获得对应的醉拳拳法。
description_en: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn.  Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.
notes_zh: 大地战士将继承酒仙的所有光环，以及真视宝石的真视效果。
烈火战士拥有相位移动的能力。
技能结束后，酒仙会根据大地→狂风→烈火的顺序选择未阵亡的元素重生。

scepter.zh: 元素分离获得%scepter_bonus_levels%级最高和当前等级，强化元素战士和他们的技能。元素分离可以提前结束，而且元素分离开始时元素战士是浸酒状态。
scepter.en: Primal Split gains %scepter_bonus_levels% max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities.Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.

subject: shadow_demon_disruption
description_zh: 将目标单位从战场上放逐一段时间。回归时会产生该单位的2个具有额外基础攻击力的幻象，受暗影恶魔控制。
description_en: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration.  Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.

subject: shadow_demon_disseminate
description_zh: 只要目标受到伤害，目标附近%radius%范围内所有敌人，若目标为敌人那也包括目标自身，他们都将受到该伤害的一定百分比。可以对敌方或友方目标施放。敌人被崩裂禁锢隐藏时效果暂停。
description_en: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within %radius% range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

subject: shadow_demon_shadow_poison
description_zh: 在一条直线上造成伤害，并以毒咒折磨敌方单位。根据目标身上的叠加层数，毒咒造成1/2/4/8/16倍的叠加伤害，至多%max_multiply_stacks%层。更多层的叠加每层造成%bonus_stack_damage%点伤害。这部分延缓的伤害在暗影毒的持续时间结束后生效，或者使用附属技能立刻造成伤害。
description_en: Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to %max_multiply_stacks% stacks. Additional stacks cause %bonus_stack_damage% damage each.  This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.
notes_zh: 暗影剧毒可以作用处于崩裂禁锢的单位。

subject: shadow_demon_demonic_cleanse
description_zh: 净愈目标友方单位，在持续时间内移除负面效果。在持续时间结束时该单位受到治疗效果。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净愈的效果。驱散类型：弱驱散
description_en: Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration.  At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 净愈的持续时间内将持续移除目标的负面状态。

subject: shadow_demon_demonic_purge
description_zh:
净化目标敌方单位，移除增益魔法效果，并使目标在持续时间内减速。伤害在持续时间结束时计算，在此之前目标单位的移动速度缓慢地恢复。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净化的影响。

驱散类型：弱驱散
description_en:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 减速效果起始时为%max_slow%%%，然后持续减少至%min_slow%%%。
邪恶净化的持续时间内将持续移除目标的有益状态。

scepter.zh: 邪恶净化具有破坏效果，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。
scepter.en: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain %max_charges% charges.

subject: shadow_demon_menace
description_zh: 暗影恶魔的攻击会对敌人施加一个可叠加的负面状态，使他们受到的伤害增加，持续%duration%秒。
description_en: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking debuff to the enemy for %duration% seconds that increases their damage taken.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法施加新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的状态失效。

subject: lone_druid_entangle
description_zh: 敌方英雄获得%hits_required%层叠加效果后独行德鲁伊可以缠绕敌方英雄。被缠绕的英雄无法移动，并受到持续伤害。施放时，对区域内每个敌方英雄施加%hits_incremented_on_active%层叠加效果，对敌方非英雄单位施加%hits_required%层。独行德鲁伊的攻击还会被强化%lone_druid_buff_duration%秒，每次攻击敌方英雄都会施加%lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip%层叠加效果。被缠绕的英雄无法获得叠加层数。升级这个技能也会升级熊灵的缠绕之爪技能。
description_en: Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.When cast, applies %hits_incremented_on_active% stacks to each enemy hero in the area and %hits_required% stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for %lone_druid_buff_duration%s, making him apply %lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.
notes_zh: 被缠绕的单位将无法使用闪烁类技能，如果进入隐身状态也会显形。
独行德鲁伊的强化增益和敌人叠加计数减益无法被驱散。
缠绕的减益效果可以被驱散。
独行德鲁伊或者熊灵的攻击不会使非英雄单位获得叠加效果，只会在施放缠绕之根时使他们被缠绕。
对肉山的作用机制和英雄相同。

scepter.zh: 缠绕之根会对区域内敌方英雄施加%hits_required%层叠加效果，并且作用范围提升。触发缠绕的敌人不再受到保护，可以继续获得新的叠加层数。
scepter.en: Entangle applies %hits_required% stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.

subject: lone_druid_spirit_link
description_zh: 连接独行德鲁伊和熊灵，提升双方的移动速度，另外双方共享一定百分比的吸血效果。
description_en: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
notes_zh: 破坏会使共享吸血效果失效。

subject: lone_druid_savage_roar
description_zh: 独行德鲁伊和熊灵发出野性的咆哮，使周围敌人恐惧，朝自己的基地狂奔。敌人的移动速度将增加%bonus_speed%%%。
description_en: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by %bonus_speed%%%.
notes_zh: 被缠绕的英雄将无法移动。
与熊灵共享冷却时间。

shard.zh: 施加弱驱散效果，并对施法者附近范围内友军提供移动速度和攻击速度加成。施法效果会在独行德鲁伊和熊灵之间复制，不论双方是否可以施法。驱散类型：弱驱散
shard.en: Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed. Replicates between Lone Druid and Spirit Bear regardless of castability on the other.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

subject: lone_druid_spirit_bear
description_zh:
召唤一只可以装备物品的熊灵伙伴。若熊灵与独行德鲁伊的距离超过%bear_attack_leash_range%，则不能攻击。如果熊灵死亡，独行德鲁伊会受到自身最大生命值的%backlash_damage%%%作为反冲伤害。
熊灵拥有粉碎击、回归、缠绕之爪、野蛮咆哮和灵魂链接技能。
description_en:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.If the bear moves %bear_attack_leash_range% distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack.  Lone Druid suffers %backlash_damage%%% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
notes_zh: 熊灵受到的大多数技能效果与英雄相同。
熊灵的基础属性为0，基础护甲为0并拥有%base_magic_resistance%%%基础魔法抗性。熊灵装备的物品或享受的加成效果具有的属性对熊灵的加成效果与全才英雄类似。
熊灵无法获得经验。熊灵会跟随独行德鲁伊一起升级。
熊灵拥有自己的阿哈利姆神杖和魔晶升级效果。
熊灵会获得独行德鲁伊身上中立物品的复制品。这件复制品拥有独立的冷却时间。

subject: lone_druid_true_form
description_zh: 独行德鲁伊将自己的形态变换为狂怒的熊，失去远程攻击的能力，但是获得额外护甲，额外生命值和额外攻击力。
description_en: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.

subject: chaos_knight_chaos_bolt
description_zh: 对目标单位投掷一支神秘的能量箭。造成随机时间的眩晕和随机的伤害。
description_en: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
notes_zh: 眩晕持续时间和伤害值为负相关。
附近的幻象也会模仿施法动作。

shard.zh: 混乱之箭会制造一个混沌之军的幻象来攻击目标。这个幻象造成的伤害减少%illusion_damage_reduction_pct%%%。
shard.en: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals %illusion_damage_reduction_pct%%% less damage.

subject: chaos_knight_reality_rift
description_zh: 将混沌骑士及混沌骑士的幻象和目标单位传送到混沌骑士与目标连线上的一点。降低敌方单位的护甲，持续%duration%秒。
description_en: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for %duration%s.
notes_zh: 目标单位将会强制面向混沌骑士，而且混沌骑士和幻象默认对目标发动攻击。

subject: chaos_knight_chaos_strike
description_zh: 混沌骑士和他的幻象在攻击时有几率造成威力不一的致命一击，并且触发时具有吸血效果。对非英雄单位的吸血效果减少。
description_en: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.

subject: chaos_knight_fundamental_forging
name_zh: 混沌骑士·基本法则锻造
description_zh: 混沌骑士的中立物品额外获得一个随机附魔。
description_en: Chaos Knight's Neutral Items get an additional random enchantment.
notes_zh: 随机附魔会从该级别的所有可选附魔中选取，包括一般不会对力量英雄开放的附魔，拥有负面效果的附魔除外。
随机附魔不会和选定附魔重复。

subject: chaos_knight_phantasm
description_zh:
从其他维度召唤若干个混沌骑士的幻象。幻象继承%outgoing_damage_tooltip%%%攻击力，但是承受%incoming_damage_tooltip%%%伤害。
驱散类型：弱驱散
description_en:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal %outgoing_damage_tooltip%%% damage, but take %incoming_damage_tooltip%%% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 能够移除混沌骑士的大部分负面状态。
混沌骑士在施放时有%invuln_duration%秒的无敌时间，可以躲避眩晕和伤害技能。

scepter.zh: 增加被动效果。混沌骑士产生幻象时都会有%bonus_illusion_chance%%%几率额外产生一个在其控制下的幻象。施放混沌之军时，会产生全地图上所有友方英雄的一个幻象。
scepter.en: Gains a passive component.  When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%%% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.

subject: meepo_earthbind
description_zh: 向目标地点扔出一张网，缠绕区域内所有敌方单位。
description_en: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.
notes_zh: 地之束缚可以使敌方单位在进入隐身后显形，但是不能作用于已经隐身的单位。
对减益免疫单位和肉山无效。

subject: meepo_poof
description_zh: 通过从大地中汲取神秘的能量，一个米波可以在持续施法%cast_duration%秒后传送至另一个米波或自身所在之处，在离开和到达的区域都对敌人造成伤害。如果技能设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，所有米波也会对目标施放忽悠。对地施放后，除了选中的米波外所有米波会忽悠至最近的地点。
description_en: Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for %cast_duration% seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations. If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
notes_zh: 可以点击小地图施放。
可以传送至米波的幻象。

subject: meepo_ransack
description_zh: 每次攻击都会窃取敌人的生命值，并治疗所有其他米波相同数值生命。对非英雄单位的效果减少至60%。
description_en: Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.Reduced to 60% against creeps.
notes_zh: 治疗数值会被生命回复增强效果提升。

subject: meepo_petrify
description_zh: 挖掘进入地下，对自身施加驱散效果，无敌且不能作为目标，持续%duration%秒。持续时间内回复最大生命值的%hp_restore%%%。被缠绕时无法施放。驱散类型：弱驱散
description_en: Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for %duration%s. Restores %hp_restore%%% of his max health over that duration.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

subject: meepo_megameepo
description_zh:
主米波将%radius%范围内其他米波放到自己的肩膀上。在这个形态下，他会获得其他米波%stats_pct%%%的属性，并且可以把他们扔向敌人，造成伤害和减速。

生效时地之束缚会产生额外的网，身上每只米波都会使忽悠造成额外%poof_damage_factor%%%伤害。
description_en:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a %radius% radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains %stats_pct%%% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

 When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals %poof_damage_factor%%% more damage for each Meepo on top.

subject: meepo_divided_we_stand
description_zh: 米波再召唤出一个米波，可以跟随米波本体升级并共用物品。技能的冷却时间相互独立，但是物品的冷却时间在米波之间共用，回城卷轴除外。来自物品的攻击力、攻击速度、生命值、魔法值、恢复效果、法力损毁和触发几率会根据米波数量均分，在每只身上的效果减少%dps_penalty_pct%%%。任意米波阵亡都会导致所有米波全体死亡。
description_en: Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls. Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them %dps_penalty_pct%%% less effective.If any Meepo dies, they all die.

subject: meepo_geomancy
description_zh: 米波会根据所在地形给予自身和克隆体可叠加的加成效果。每个米波都会给予其他米波自身的加成。如果%tree_radius%范围内有树木，他会获得%tree_regen%点/秒生命恢复。如果他站在土地上，他会获得%dirt_move_speed%%%移动速度加成。如果他在水中，他的攻击会减缓目标%water_move_slow%%%移速，持续%water_slow_duration%秒。
description_en: Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain.  Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.If there is a tree within %tree_radius% range, he receives %tree_regen% HP regen.If he is standing on dirt, he receives %dirt_move_speed%%% bonus movement speed.If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by %water_move_slow%%% for %water_slow_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 土地包括所有水之外的地形。

subject: meepo_megameepo_fling
description_zh: 在超大米波形态下，米波将最上端的米波向%AbilityCastRange%范围内目标扔出，造成伤害和减速。
description_en: In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a %AbilityCastRange% range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术反弹。

subject: treant_natures_grasp
description_zh: 朝目标地点制造藤蔓。藤蔓对穿过的敌人造成减速和伤害。对非英雄单位造成的伤害减少%creep_penalty%%%。
description_en: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does %creep_penalty%%% less damage to creeps.

subject: treant_leech_seed
description_zh: 树精卫士的攻击会对敌方单位种下一颗吸取生命的种子。该单位会受到额外魔法伤害，被缠绕和缴械一小段时间，并放出%healing_pulse_count%次治疗脉冲，最多对附近%max_heal_units%名友军根据当次攻击造成的伤害进行治疗。
description_en: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits %healing_pulse_count% healing pulses to up to %max_heal_units% nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.

subject: treant_living_armor
description_zh: 将目标英雄或建筑笼罩在保护性外壳中，治疗目标并格挡来自玩家控制来源的伤害。每次本技能格挡伤害后，下次的伤害格挡量都会减少。如果伤害格挡量降至0，加成效果会提前移除。
description_en: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.
notes_zh: 低于%damage_block_threshold%点的伤害会被无视。

subject: treant_eyes_in_the_forest
description_zh: 树精卫士对目标树木灌注魔力。注魔后树木将拥有周围的顺畅视野。树眼持续%duration%秒，为隐形状态，但是寄生的树木被摧毁或者树眼直接被攻击后都会被摧毁。
description_en: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for %duration% seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
notes_zh: 丛林之眼的树木产生的疯狂生长效果也可以造成伤害。
如果敌人拥有真实视域，他们将会发现被灌注魔力的树木。

subject: treant_natures_guise
description_zh: 只要靠近树木就会获得移动速度加成。树精卫士在%cooldown_time%秒内不受到伤害就会额外获得树木穿行。树木穿行时，自然蔽护可以主动使用，使树精卫士获得隐身状态，直到他主动攻击，或不再靠近树木。
description_en: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for %cooldown_time% seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
notes_zh: 自然蔽护效果下树精卫士可以直接穿过树木。
自然卷握的藤蔓在这个技能下被视为树木。
树木穿行时，受到伤害并不会禁用主动效果或树木穿行。

subject: treant_overgrowth
description_zh: 在树精卫士周围召唤出疯狂生长的伤害性藤条和枝干，造成伤害并且阻止被缠绕的敌人移动、闪烁、进入隐身或攻击。
description_en: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.
notes_zh: 效果无视减益免疫，但是在期间获得减益免疫状态将挣脱控制。

scepter.zh: 冷却时间降低至%AbilityCooldown%秒。施放疯狂生长时，树精卫士从土壤中汲取力量，他的身体急剧增大，持续%bloom_duration%秒。变大后他会获得相位移动状态，移动速度为固定%movement_speed%，%strength_bonus%%%力量加成，并且拥有在%splash_radius%范围内造成%splash_pct%%%攻击伤害的溅射攻击。
scepter.en: Decreases Cooldown to %AbilityCooldown% seconds. When casting Overgrowth, Treant Protector draws power from the soil, greatly increasing his size for %bloom_duration% seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of %movement_speed%, %strength_bonus%%% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals %splash_pct%%% of his attack damage in a %splash_radius% unit radius.

subject: ogre_magi_fireblast
name_zh: 食人魔魔法师·火焰爆轰
description_zh: 以一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成伤害并使目标眩晕。
description_en: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有%multicast_delay%秒的间隔。

scepter.zh: 很精通的火焰爆轰，冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒，施法速度提升%bonus_cast_speed%%%。
scepter.en: Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increasing cast speed by %bonus_cast_speed%%%.

subject: ogre_magi_ignite
description_zh: 使目标和另一个随机单位浸透在挥发性化学物质中，导致其瞬间被火焰吞噬。目标处在极度痛苦之中，受到伤害并且移动缓慢。
description_en: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
notes_zh: 多重施法将使此技能有几率对%ignite_multicast_aoe%范围内的随机敌方单位进行多次施放。
引燃现在击中已受到作用的单位后会增加持续时间。

subject: ogre_magi_bloodlust
description_zh: 激起一个友方单位的狂暴，增加其移动和攻击速度。对食人魔魔法师自身施放时攻击速度加成更高。可以对防御塔施放。
description_en: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attack speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，%multicast_bloodlust_aoe%范围内的友方单位将随机获得嗜血术效果。

subject: ogre_magi_unrefined_fireblast
name_zh: 食人魔魔法师·未精通的火焰爆轰
description_zh: 操控一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成%base_damage% + %str_multiplier%倍食人魔力量的伤害并使目标眩晕。魔法消耗为食人魔魔法师当前魔法的%scepter_mana%%%。
description_en: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing %base_damage% + %str_multiplier%x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is %scepter_mana%%% of Ogre Magi's current mana.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有%multicast_delay%秒的间隔。

subject: ogre_magi_smash
name_zh: 食人魔魔法师·烈火护盾
description_zh: 创造一个围绕友军目标的护盾，吸收接下来%attacks%次来自敌方英雄攻击的一定百分比伤害。吸收伤害后向攻击者发射火球。可以对防御塔施放。
description_en: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next %attacks% attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，%multicast_fireshield_aoe%范围内的友方单位将随机获得烈火护盾效果。

subject: ogre_magi_dumb_luck
description_zh: 食人魔魔法师的智力值上限为0。他通过力量来获得魔法和魔法恢复。
description_en: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.

subject: ogre_magi_multicast
name_zh: 食人魔魔法师·多重施法
description_zh: 使食人魔魔法师在单次施法中有概率多次施放同一技能和物品。每%strength_for_one_pct%点力量提升%one_tooltip%%%多重施法几率。
description_en: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use. Each point of Strength adds to Multicast chance. Every %strength_for_one_pct% Strength adds %one_tooltip%%%.
notes_zh: 只有指向性技能和物品有几率触发多重施法。
指向性技能和物品额外对食人魔周围一定作用范围内敌人和中立生物生效。火焰爆轰和未精通的火焰爆轰将对同个目标生效多次。

subject: undying_decay
description_zh: 不朽尸王偷取区域内所有敌方英雄的力量，造成基础伤害并将敌人的力量据为己有。对非英雄单位造成%creep_damage_multiplier%倍伤害。
description_en: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals %creep_damage_multiplier%x damage to creeps.
notes_zh: 窃据的力量可以叠加，但是敌方英雄的力量至少为1点。
力量的窃取先于技能造成的伤害。
可以作用隐形单位。

scepter.zh: 提升力量窃取。
scepter.en: Increases strength steal.

subject: undying_soul_rip
description_zh: 不朽尸王从附近的所有单位身上扯出生命力，并使用它治疗队友或伤害敌人。可以使用噬魂治疗墓碑。
description_en: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
notes_zh: 可以治疗墓碑，但是不能治疗或伤害其他建筑。
不会扯出隐身单位、无敌单位、战争迷雾内单位或减益免疫敌人的生命力。
可以扯出减益免疫友军，包括僵尸的生命力。

subject: undying_tombstone
description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一座墓碑。墓碑会不断在其附近的每个敌方单位身边产生僵尸攻击他们。僵尸拥有死亡渴望技能，使他们的攻击带有减速效果，并且若目标的生命值低于一定百分比，僵尸的攻击和移动速度会提升。
description_en: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
notes_zh: 墓碑免疫技能，但是可以被噬魂治疗。
僵尸和墓碑均免疫技能。
如果初始目标死亡或丢失视野，僵尸将会死亡。

shard.zh: 墓碑可以对友方英雄施放，让他们躲进墓碑。进入墓碑的英雄%tombstone_bunker_cd%秒内无法离开，离开后同样的时间内无法再次进入。如果英雄在内时墓碑被摧毁，该英雄会被眩晕%tombstone_stun_penalty%秒。
shard.en: Tombstone can be cast on an allied hero to bunker inside of the tombstone. Heroes that enter the Tombstone cannot leave for %tombstone_bunker_cd% seconds nor can they re-enter after leaving. If the tombstone is destroyed with a hero inside, that hero gets stunned for %tombstone_stun_penalty% seconds.

subject: undying_ceaseless_dirge
description_zh: 不朽尸王阵亡时会立刻在泉水复活。比赛开始时处于冷却状态。无法被刷新。
description_en: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain. Begins the game on cooldown. Cannot be refreshed.

subject: undying_flesh_golem
description_zh: 不朽尸王变身为一具令人毛骨悚然的血肉傀儡。在这个状态下，他获得一定百分比的力量加成，移动速度加成，并且攻击附带减速和伤害加深效果，还会产生墓碑的僵尸。
description_en: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem.  While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.

subject: rubick_telekinesis
description_zh: 拉比克利用他的隔空取物能力，将敌人短暂抬到空中，然后猛投向地面。被投下的单位会砸晕落地点附近的敌人。
description_en: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
notes_zh: 目标滞空时，拉比克可以使用次级技能将目标扔往目标方向。
单位落地后，自身不会受到范围眩晕效果。

shard.zh: 可以对自身或友军施放隔空取物。投掷距离增加至%max_land_distance%，投掷延迟降低至%shard_teammate_throw_delay%秒。
shard.en: Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw distance is increased to %max_land_distance% and throw delay is reduced to %shard_teammate_throw_delay% seconds.

subject: rubick_fade_bolt
description_zh: 拉比克制造一道强大的奥术能量流，在多个敌方单位之间流动，造成伤害并降低他们的攻击力和技能伤害。每次跳跃造成的伤害递减。
description_en: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.

subject: rubick_arcane_supremacy
description_zh: 拉比克对奥术的熟稔使他拥有更远的施法距离，和额外技能增强。
description_en: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.

subject: rubick_spell_steal
description_zh: 拉比克钻研一个敌方英雄的魔法精华之痕，学习这个英雄最后释放的技能的秘密。拉比克将可以使用这个技能，维持几分钟或直到他死亡。
description_en: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
notes_zh: 无法窃取物品类技能。
拉比克若拥有阿哈利姆魔晶，则窃取的技能会是魔晶升级版本。
不会触发法术反弹。

scepter.zh: 可窃取的技能提升至2个。提升施法距离，并且窃取的技能会升级成神杖版本。
scepter.en: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.

shard.zh: 窃取的技能升级为相应的魔晶版本。
shard.en: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.

subject: rubick_curiosity
description_zh: 拉比克现在每级获得%curiosity_per_level%层奇心的叠加效果，每层奇心提供%curiosity_attack_damage%点基础攻击力，%curiosity_modifier_amp%%%增益/减益持续时间，和%curiosity_aoe_bonus%作用范围加成。如果拉比克看到%charge_radius%范围内有敌方英雄施放技能，他就会获得%curiosity_per_spell_cast%层奇心，持续%curiosity_duration%秒。如果当前提供临时奇心的敌人在受到来自拉比克的伤害后%grace_period%秒内阵亡，他就会永久获得%curiosity_per_kill%层奇心。
description_en: Rubick gains %curiosity_per_level% stack of Curiosity per level that grants him %curiosity_attack_damage% base damage, %curiosity_modifier_amp%%% Buff/Debuff Duration, and %curiosity_aoe_bonus% AOE Bonus. If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within %charge_radius% distance of him, he gains %curiosity_per_spell_cast% Curiosity for %curiosity_duration% seconds.  If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last %grace_period% seconds, he gains %curiosity_per_kill% Curiosity permanently.

subject: disruptor_thunder_strike
description_zh: 用闪电反复打击目标单位。每次打击会伤害附近小范围内的敌方单位，并施加%slow_duration%秒的%slow_amount%%%攻击速度和移动速度降低效果。提供目标的视野。
description_en: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by %slow_amount%%% for %slow_duration% seconds.  Provides vision of its target.

subject: disruptor_glimpse
description_zh: 将目标英雄传送回他%backtrack_time%秒前所在位置。瞬间消灭幻象单位。根据瞥视距离的一定百分比造成伤害，不能超过最大伤害。
description_en: Teleports the target hero back to where it was %backtrack_time% seconds ago.  Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
notes_zh: 飞行时间由目标的飞行距离决定。

subject: disruptor_kinetic_field
description_zh: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一个敌人无法通过的环形动能屏障。
description_en: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
notes_zh: 力场不能困住减益免疫单位。

subject: disruptor_kinetic_fence
description_zh: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一面敌人无法通过的动能墙壁。
description_en: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.

subject: disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion
description_zh: 每当干扰者受到%effect_radius%范围内来自任意来源的%damage_threshold%点伤害，附近所有敌人都会受到%damage_per_int%倍干扰者智力值的伤害，并且被推开最多%effect_radius%距离。
description_en: Whenever Disruptor takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source within %effect_radius% radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to %damage_per_int%x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a %effect_radius% distance away.
notes_zh: %damage_reset_interval%秒后伤害计数会重置。

subject: disruptor_static_storm
description_zh: 创造一场静态风暴，在持续时间内伤害并沉默区域内的所有敌方单位。伤害刚开始时很低，但会在持续时间内逐渐增加。
description_en: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.

scepter.zh: 锁闭物品。
scepter.en: Mutes items.

subject: nyx_assassin_impale
description_zh: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位受到伤害，然后被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕。
description_en: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
notes_zh: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒%speed%，最远作用距离为%length%。
穿刺不会被林肯法球格挡。

subject: nyx_assassin_jolt
description_zh: 造成等同于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的伤害，并燃烧部分魔法。另外还会根据过去%damage_echo_duration%秒内目标受到来自司夜刺客的伤害再造成一定百分比的伤害。施加伤害前会重置累计伤害。
description_en: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last %damage_echo_duration%s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.

subject: nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace
description_zh:
激活状态下，尖刺外壳可以反弹并无效化司夜刺客受到的伤害（每个攻击者最多作用一次），同时眩晕攻击者。激活尖刺外壳不会打破复仇的隐身状态。

钻地状态下尖刺外壳施放后将立刻眩晕周围的敌人。
description_en:
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.

While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
notes_zh: 反弹的伤害与司夜刺客本应受到的实际伤害相同。
尖刺外壳只有在受到玩家控制来源的伤害后会反弹。
反弹的伤害与司夜刺客受到的伤害类型相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

subject: nyx_assassin_burrow
description_zh: 司夜刺客经过短时间的掘地后钻入地下。钻地后尖刺外壳一施放就会直接眩晕附近所有敌人，神智爆裂和穿刺的施法距离提升，穿刺的冷却时间减少。钻地后司夜刺客固定在原地，无法攻击，并且是隐身状态。同时司夜刺客受到的所有伤害都会降低。
description_en: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.
notes_zh: 施放复仇将取消钻地状态。

subject: nyx_assassin_neuro_sting
description_zh: 司夜刺客对敌人造成伤害还会燃烧造成伤害一定百分比的魔法。
description_en: Nyx Assassin's damage on enemies also burns mana as a percentage of the damage dealt.

subject: nyx_assassin_vendetta
description_zh: 司夜刺客进入隐身状态并获得移动速度加成。如果司夜刺客以攻击打破隐身，当次攻击将造成超高额外伤害，并对目标施加破坏效果。司夜刺客当次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且攻击动作加快%attack_animation_bonus%%%。
description_en: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has %attack_range_bonus% additional attack range and a %attack_animation_bonus%%% faster attack animation for this attack.
notes_zh: 如果在隐身期间使用了技能，或者隐身时间结束，额外伤害的效果将会消失。
会在造成额外伤害前施加破坏效果。

shard.zh: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。在复仇的最初%free_pathing_duration%秒内，司夜刺客为极速状态，并且移动无视地形。
shard.en: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. For the first %free_pathing_duration%s of Vendetta, Nyx is hasted and has unobstructed pathing.

subject: naga_siren_mirror_image
description_zh:
制造多个受娜迦海妖控制的镜像。

驱散类型：弱驱散
description_en:
Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 娜迦海妖在施法时有%invuln_duration%秒的无敌时间，可以用来躲避眩晕和伤害。
施放后，将会移除娜迦海妖身上大部分效果。
施放时现有的镜像幻象将被摧毁。

subject: naga_siren_ensnare
description_zh: 打断目标的动作并将其困在原地，使其无法移动或闪烁。可以对海妖之歌作用下的单位施放。
description_en: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.

scepter.zh: 提升施法距离和弹道速度。诱捕可以对减益免疫单位施放并且生效。诱捕会施加破坏效果。
scepter.en: Increases cast range and projectile speed.  Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.

subject: naga_siren_rip_tide
description_zh: 娜迦海妖和她的幻象每经过%hits%次攻击后就会对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低他们的护甲，持续%duration%秒。
description_en: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for %duration% seconds every %hits% attacks.
notes_zh: 使用激流不会打断持续施法。

subject: naga_siren_eelskin
description_zh: 娜迦海妖拥有闪避加成，%radius%内每增加一个娜迦海妖都会提升。
description_en: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within %radius% radius.

subject: naga_siren_song_of_the_siren
description_zh: 娜迦海妖周围的所有敌人受到魔法影响陷入停滞状态，既无法行动也不会受到攻击。再次使用海妖之歌可以提前停止效果。
description_en: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.
notes_zh: 海妖之歌作用下的单位处于无敌状态，不会受到任何伤害。
海妖之歌的作用范围以娜迦海妖为中心，如果她远离了作用单位，他们将会醒来。

shard.zh: 海妖之歌范围内友军每秒会恢复一定百分比的生命和魔法。
shard.en: Allies in range of Song of the Siren recover a percentage of their health and mana per second.

subject: keeper_of_the_light_illuminate
description_zh: 持续施法 - 引导光的能量，持续施法的时间越长，威力越大。释放后，光波沿直线向前发出，造成伤害并获得沿途的视野。
description_en: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
notes_zh: 在持续施法期间获得的视野不断增大。

subject: keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light
description_zh: 一道致盲之光在目标区域闪现，把区域内的单位击退到区域边缘，并造成致盲，使他们的部分攻击不能命中。最短击退距离是在%knockback_duration%秒内击退%knockback_distance%距离。
description_en: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is %knockback_distance% range over %knockback_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 落地后受作用单位将摧毁150范围内的树木。

subject: keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic
description_zh: 恢复目标单位的魔法值，并减少所有冷却中基础技能（非大招）的冷却时间。对自身使用时效果提升%self_bonus%%%。
description_en: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is %self_bonus%%% more effective when used on himself.
notes_zh: 查克拉魔法无法减少终极技能的冷却时间。

subject: keeper_of_the_light_radiant_bind
description_zh: 削弱一个敌人的魔法抗性，并施加减速效果，目标移动的距离越长，减速效果越大。
description_en: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.

shard.zh: 获得%AbilityCharges%点能量点数。
shard.en: Grants %AbilityCharges% charges.

subject: keeper_of_the_light_will_o_wisp
description_zh: 在目标区域召唤幻火。幻火交替闪亮和闪灭。闪亮时蛊惑敌人靠近，并造成伤害。
description_en: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
notes_zh: 幻火会对作用范围内所有敌人施加朝其牵引的效果，该牵引效果不会打断。

subject: keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form
description_zh: 伊扎洛暂时使身体发光，获得施法距离加成，提升光明速度的移速加成，并且冲击波将由一个单独的灵魂施法，可以治疗友军。
description_en: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.

shard.zh: 提升冲击波的治疗效果。
shard.en: Increases illuminate heal.

subject: keeper_of_the_light_bright_speed
description_zh: 光之守卫每%intelligence_per_speed%点智力都会获得1移动速度。只要光之守卫移动%movement_per_vision%距离，他就会留下一道光，可以看到%vision_radius%范围，持续%vision_duration%秒。
description_en: Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every %intelligence_per_speed% Intelligence.Whenever Keeper of the Light moves %movement_per_vision% distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see %vision_radius% range for %vision_duration% seconds.

subject: wisp_tether
description_zh: 将艾欧和一个友方单位连接在一起，提高双方的移动速度。当艾欧回复生命或魔法时，连在一起的友军将获得一部分回复效果。距离过远时连接将会断开，也可以主动断开连接。羁绊会减速触碰到的敌人。
description_en: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
notes_zh: 如果羁绊的目标距离艾欧700码以外，艾欧将链接目标并将自己向目标牵引（牵引后相距300码）。
被羁绊连接的单位回复速度相比更快，艾欧满血时也能回复。
艾欧的移动速度与羁绊目标一致。

shard.zh: 羁绊会对触碰到的敌人造成伤害。艾欧会回复%damage_to_heal%%%造成伤害。
shard.en: Tether damages enemies touching it. Io is healed for %damage_to_heal%%% of the damage done.

subject: wisp_spirits
description_zh: 召唤五个围绕艾欧起舞的幽魂，对所有碰触到的单位造成伤害。如果碰到的是敌方英雄，幽魂会爆炸，对其附近的所有敌人造成伤害。普通单位碰到幽魂会受到轻微伤害，但是不会使其爆炸。持续时间结束后，幽魂将自动爆炸。
description_en: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
notes_zh: 召唤后艾欧可以拉近或拉远幽魂。

scepter.zh: 每秒被动产生幽魂围绕艾欧，直至数量上限。幽魂撞到英雄会将其短暂减速。可以主动施放来引爆幽魂。
scepter.en: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.

subject: wisp_overcharge
description_zh: 艾欧获得攻击速度、技能增强和基于最大生命值的生命恢复。如果艾欧和一个友军连接，该单位也会获得过载提供的所有增益效果。
description_en: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.

subject: wisp_spirits_in
description_zh: 让幽魂靠近你。可以切换开关状态。
description_en: Sends the spirits closer to you. Can be toggled on and off.

subject: wisp_spirits_out
description_zh: 让幽魂远离你。可以切换开关状态。
description_en: Sends the spirits farther away from you. Can be toggled on and off.

subject: wisp_relocate
description_zh: 将艾欧和与其连接的友军传送到地图上任何位置。持续时间结束后艾欧和相连的友军会被传送回原位。双击将传送回己方的泉水。
description_en: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
notes_zh: 敌人在施法延迟期间会在大地图和小地图上目标区域都收到视觉特效提示。
如果艾欧在施法延迟期间被控制，降临将会取消。
如果羁绊连接了友方英雄，该英雄将和你一起被传送。你可以随时断开连接，防止英雄和你一同传送。
只有英雄、类英雄单位和幻象可以降临。

subject: wisp_equilibrium
description_zh: 艾欧获得伤害输出增强，血量越高，数值越高。同时，艾欧还获得生命回复和治疗增强，血量越低，数值越高。
description_en: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

subject: visage_grave_chill
description_zh: 维萨吉吸取目标单位的移动和攻击速度，自身和附近的佣兽获得等量加成。
description_en: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.
notes_zh: 两个状态效果是分开驱散的。
速度加成和目标的速度减少相互独立。
维萨吉周围%radius%内的佣兽也将获得黄泉颤抖的加成效果。

subject: visage_soul_assumption
description_zh: 每次附近英雄（不论敌我）受到的伤害超过%damage_limit%点，维萨吉就能集聚灵魂精华的能量。将精华释放后，会对目标单位造成基础伤害，每一点集聚的能量还将造成额外伤害。
description_en: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than %damage_limit% damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.
notes_zh: 能量点数只计算来自玩家或肉山的伤害，必须大于%damage_min%点小于%damage_max%点。自残型伤害和灵魂超度造成的伤害不计算在内。

subject: visage_gravekeepers_cloak
description_zh: 维萨吉产生数层屏障来保护他，降低受到的伤害。每当他受到来自玩家的伤害，就会失去一层屏障，失去的屏障需要一定时间才能恢复。维萨吉的佣兽在%radius%范围内也会受到斗篷的保护，承伤降低的数值取决于维萨吉拥有的层数。
description_en: Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage.  If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within %radius% range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
notes_zh: 每次维萨吉受到来自其他玩家的伤害超过最小伤害时，保护层就会移除一层。
佣兽在维萨吉周围%radius%范围内将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

shard.zh: 获得主动效果，维萨吉可以化作石像形态，对身边375范围内的敌人造成0.8/1.0/1.2秒眩晕，同时造成60/100/140点伤害，获得6秒无敌状态。最多恢复%shard_hp_restoration_pct%%%生命值。
shard.en: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds.  Restores up to %shard_hp_restoration_pct%%% of your health.

subject: visage_silent_as_the_grave
description_zh: 维萨吉获得飞行移动状态和移动速度加成。攻击或施法后，将失去移速加成和飞行移动状态，同时维萨吉和他的佣兽在%bonus_duration%秒内拥有额外攻击力。
description_en: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed.  Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for %bonus_duration%s.

scepter.zh: 移动速度、额外攻击力和持续时间提升。维萨吉和佣兽在持续时间内为隐身状态，直到失去飞行移动状态。
scepter.en: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.

subject: visage_summon_familiars
description_zh:
召唤%familiar_count%只盲眼的佣兽为维萨吉作战。佣兽拥有石像形态技能，可以化为石像，在落地时使敌人眩晕。在石像形态中的佣兽无敌，并且迅速回复生命值。佣兽被击杀时给予高额奖励。

技能可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，在此期间佣兽无法攻击或行动。
description_en:
Conjures %familiar_count% blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
notes_zh: 施放召唤佣兽后已有的佣兽将会死亡。
佣兽在维萨吉周围时将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果和黄泉颤抖的加成效果。

subject: slark_dark_pact
description_zh:
短暂延迟后，斯拉克牺牲部分生命力，清除大部分负面状态并对自己和周围敌方单位造成伤害。斯拉克自身只受到造成伤害的%self_damage_pct%%%。

驱散类型：强驱散
description_en:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself.  Slark only takes %self_damage_pct%%% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes_zh: 经过%delay%秒施法延迟后，每隔%pulse_interval%秒释放1道伤害波造成伤害，总共%total_pulses%道。
每道伤害波还会移除斯拉克身上的负面效果。
不能使用此技能自杀。
如果斯拉克死亡，伤害波将停止释放。

subject: slark_pounce
description_zh: 斯拉克向前跳跃，束缚第一个碰到的英雄并施加能量转移的叠加效果。该单位只能在斯拉克着地点附近的有限范围内移动。
description_en: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
notes_zh: 施放后斯拉克以%pounce_speed%的速度向前跳跃，抓住敌方英雄或跳跃%pounce_distance%距离后停下。
不能束缚减益免疫单位。
斯拉克落地点附近的树木将会被摧毁。

scepter.zh: 变为充能型技能，并且提升距离。
scepter.en: Provides charges and increases range.

subject: slark_saltwater_shiv
description_zh: 斯拉克用他的海浪短刀划开目标，窃取目标一部分的移动速度、生命恢复和生命回复。这个效果独立叠加。
description_en: Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.These effects stack independently.

subject: slark_depth_shroud
description_zh: 在目标地点创造一团云雾。作用范围内所有友军为隐藏状态，受到暗影之舞的作用。
description_en: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.

subject: slark_essence_shift
description_zh: 斯拉克的攻击会偷走敌方英雄的生命能量，每次吸取他们的%stat_loss%点全属性并转化成自身额外%agi_gain%点敏捷值。只要敌方英雄带着该效果在斯拉克300范围内阵亡，他将永久窃取%stat_loss%点敏捷。
description_en: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining %stat_loss% of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus %agi_gain% Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %stat_loss% Agility.
notes_zh: 属性值最少为1点。
斯拉克或受到作用的单位死亡后，阵亡单位因能量转移变化的属性值将回归正常。但是两方的属性值相互独立，并无关联。
斯拉克无需完成击杀就能永久窃取敏捷，只要敌方英雄身上拥有能量转移状态时在斯拉克的窃取范围内阵亡即可。
破坏会使技能无法获得临时的叠加效果。依然可以获得永久的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

subject: slark_shadow_dance
description_zh: 当斯拉克不处于敌方视野内时，他会被动获得移动速度加成和生命恢复。如果受到来自中立单位的伤害，%neutral_disable%秒内会失去被动移速和生命恢复加成。主动开启后，斯拉克将自己藏进暗影之云，变成隐身状态，不会被反隐手段发现。攻击、施法、使用物品都不会使斯拉克显形，但是敌人可以看见暗影之云。
description_en: When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration.  If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.

subject: medusa_split_shot
description_zh: 美杜莎施展魔法将她的箭分裂成若干支箭矢。分裂箭造成的伤害为正常攻击力的一定百分比。额外目标不会受到其他攻击特效（比如致命一击）的作用。
description_en: Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
notes_zh: 次级目标将是除了主要目标外距离最近的敌方单位。
如果在分裂箭激活的状态下创造幻象，幻象也将继承此技能。

scepter.zh: 使分裂箭的次级攻击也能继承攻击特效，并且目标数量提升。
scepter.en: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.

subject: medusa_mystic_snake
description_zh: 放出一条秘术异蛇在敌人之间跳跃，造成伤害。每次跳跃后伤害和速度都会增加。抵达最后一个目标后，它会返回到美杜莎身上为其恢复魔法值。异蛇会返还所有目标最大魔法值一定百分比的魔法。
description_en: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
notes_zh: 秘术异蛇无法躲避。

subject: medusa_gorgon_grasp
description_zh: 美杜莎沿着一条直线射出%volley_count%组箭矢，每组的作用范围递增。齐射的箭矢击中的敌人会受到初始爆发伤害，然后被缠绕且无法转身，并对敌人可见，同时受到每秒伤害。
description_en: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in %volley_count% groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.

subject: medusa_cold_blooded
description_zh: 美杜莎受到指向性技能作用后会对该敌人放出单体的秘术异蛇，把他们变成石头，持续%stone_form_scepter_base_tooltip%秒。
description_en: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for %stone_form_scepter_base_tooltip%s.

subject: medusa_mana_shield
description_zh: 创造一个魔法护盾，消耗美杜莎的魔法值以吸收%absorption_pct%%%的伤害。幻象的伤害吸收系数减少%illusion_percentage%%%。
description_en: Creates a shield that absorbs %absorption_pct%%% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb %illusion_percentage%%% less damage per point of mana.
notes_zh: 伤害的吸收先于任何伤害减免机制，所以提高物理护甲，物理格挡和魔法抗性都不能减少吸收相同伤害所需的魔法。

subject: medusa_stone_gaze
description_zh: 任何盯着蛇发女妖的敌方单位的攻击速度和移动速度均将被减缓。如果一单位在石化凝视期间盯着蛇发女妖超过%face_duration%秒，该单位会被完全石化。被石化的单位处于眩晕状态，受到物理攻击时承受额外伤害。
description_en: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed.  If %face_duration% seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone.  Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
notes_zh: 无论敌方单位是在美杜莎施放技能期间的何时受到石化凝视作用，他受到的技能效果都是满额的持续时间。

subject: troll_warlord_switch_stance
description_zh: 巨魔战将从使用远程攻击切换为近战攻击。近战下巨魔战将的基础攻击间隔降低至%base_attack_time%。巨魔战将每拥有%attack_speed_interval%攻击速度加成获得%armor_per_interval%点护甲。
description_en: Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to %base_attack_time%.Troll Warlord gains %armor_per_interval% armor per %attack_speed_interval% bonus attack speed.

subject: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged
name_zh: 巨魔战将·旋风飞斧（远程）
description_zh: 巨魔战将掷出手中的五把飞斧，减速并伤害前方%axe_range%范围锥形区域内的敌方单位。
description_en: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over %axe_range% range, slowing and damaging enemy units.
notes_zh: 无法作用于肉山。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

scepter.zh: 旋风飞斧（远程）可以驱散敌人。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。驱散类型：弱驱散
scepter.en: Causes Whirling Axes (Ranged) to dispel enemies. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

subject: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee
name_zh: 巨魔战将·旋风飞斧（近战）
description_zh: 巨魔战将掷出两把飞斧环绕在他周围，使敌方单位受到伤害，并且部分普通攻击将不能命中。
description_en: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.
notes_zh: 无法作用于肉山。

scepter.zh: 旋风飞斧（近战）可以驱散自己。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。驱散类型：弱驱散
scepter.en: Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

subject: troll_warlord_fervor
description_zh: 当巨魔战将持续攻击同一个目标时，他会攻击得越来越快。如果改变目标，则额外的攻速加成清零。
description_en: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed.  If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏会使阿哈利姆魔晶的几率触发失效。

shard.zh: 巨魔战将在攻击敌方单位时拥有%base_chance%%% + 热血战魂叠加次数*%extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%%的几率对远程攻击距离 + %range_buffer%范围内任意单位发动一次额外的远程攻击。
shard.en: Grants Troll %base_chance%%% + %extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%% chance per Fervor stack of firing an additional ranged attack to any unit within its ranged attack range plus %range_buffer% when attacking an enemy unit.

subject: troll_warlord_berserkers_rage
description_zh: 近战形态下巨魔战将的攻击有几率触发诱捕，阻止目标移动或使用位移类技能。另外近战形态下还拥有额外移动速度。远程形态下巨魔战将的攻击有几率使目标残废，造成额外伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。
description_en: While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.

subject: troll_warlord_battle_trance
description_zh:
巨魔战将释放出强大的战斗专注，强迫自身持续攻击%range%距离内最近的敌方单位，以英雄优先。专注期间不会因伤害而阵亡。提供额外吸血，攻击速度，减速抗性和移动速度。施放时施加弱驱散。 

驱散类型：弱驱散
description_en:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within %range% range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, slow resistance and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 巨魔战将在战斗专注作用下仍然可以使用他的物品技能，但是无法执行其他指令。
斧王的淘汰之刃还是能斩杀巨魔战将。
巨魔战将会获得目标的视野。

subject: centaur_hoof_stomp
name_zh: 半人马战行者·马蹄践踏
description_zh: 经过短暂的蓄力后，半人马战行者猛踏地面，眩晕并伤害身边的敌方单位。在延迟期间，他被缴械，但可以移动。
description_en: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.

subject: centaur_double_edge
description_zh: 半人马战行者以猛烈的力量进行近战攻击，对目标周围单位和自身造成伤害。将基于力量值造成额外伤害。此技能无法用于自杀。
description_en: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.
notes_zh: 双刃剑对目标和自身都造成魔法伤害。

shard.zh: 双刃剑可以对敌人造成减速，并且每击中一名英雄都会暂时提升半人马战行者的力量值。每次叠加都会刷新持续时间，最多叠加%shard_max_stacks%次。
shard.en: Causes Double Edge to slow enemy heroes and increase Centaur's strength per hero hit for a short time. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of %shard_max_stacks% stacks.

subject: centaur_return
description_zh: 半人马战行者向攻击他的单位发出反击。反弹固定伤害加上自身力量的一定百分比。对防御塔的伤害减半。
description_en: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.
notes_zh: 反伤会在受到攻击时触发。
反伤能对防御塔造成伤害。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

subject: centaur_work_horse
name_zh: 半人马战行者·马到成功
description_zh: 半人马战行者套上一辆便车。开启后半人马战行者获得当前等级奔袭冲撞的加成效果，而且可以对友方目标施放便车。
description_en: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.

subject: centaur_stampede
name_zh: 半人马战行者·奔袭冲撞
description_zh: 半人马战行者带领所有队友向胜利冲锋，所有友方英雄达到极限移动速度，并使踩到的敌人减速。每个敌人只会受到一次踩踏作用，并受到基于半人马战行者力量值的伤害。
description_en: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.

subject: centaur_horsepower
name_zh: 半人马战行者·开足马力
description_zh: 半人马战行者获得移动速度加成，数值为%strength_to_movement_pct%%%自身力量值。这个移动速度加成不与鞋类物品叠加。
description_en: Centaur Warrunner gains %strength_to_movement_pct%%% of his strength as bonus movement speed. This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

subject: magnataur_shockwave
description_zh: 马格纳斯放出一道能量波，对一条直线上的敌方单位造成伤害，并将他们朝自身牵引，同时受到短暂减速效果。
description_en: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.

subject: magnataur_empower
description_zh:
对友军施放时，给予攻击力加成并使其获得分裂效果。

授予力量总是在马格纳斯身上生效，拥有%self_multiplier%%%额外效果。
description_en:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack. 

 Empower is always on Magnus with %self_multiplier%%% larger bonus.
notes_zh: 攻击力加成根据基础攻击力和主属性加成计算。
分裂伤害无视减益免疫。
远程单位的攻击没有分裂效果。

subject: magnataur_skewer
description_zh: 马格纳斯向前冲刺，用他巨大的犀角将敌人挑起。被击中的英雄将被拽至终点，然后受到伤害并且移动速度被减缓。根据行进的距离伤害也会提升。
description_en: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
notes_zh: 马格纳斯受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时，巨角冲撞都会被打断。

shard.zh: 提升距离，并且使敌人穿过树木和高台时造成额外伤害。
