scepter.en: Escape Act has %max_charges% charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.

subject: ringmaster_impalement
description_zh: 百戏大王向自己精心选择的地点扔出一把匕首。匕首击中敌人会造成即时伤害，短暂减速击中的单位，并且使他们流血。流血的英雄受到基于目标最大生命值一定百分比的每秒伤害，流血的非英雄单位受到每秒固定伤害。
description_en: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.

subject: ringmaster_spotlight
description_zh: 百戏大王用%spotlight_count%束聚光灯照亮一片区域。灯光下的敌人有几率丢失攻击，隐身状态下也会显形。被光束击中的幻象会逐渐消散，每秒失去一定百分比的最大生命值。这些效果在灯束离开后会粘滞%linger_duration%秒。
description_en: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds after leaving the light.

subject: ringmaster_wheel
description_zh: 百戏大王推出奇观轮向目标地点滚去，击退沿途的敌人。到达目的地后，范围内的敌人会持续受到伤害，并且被减速%aura_slow%%%。敌方英雄面对转轮超过%face_duration%秒会被迷住，朝其走去。首个敌人着迷后会触发转轮爆炸的倒计时。如果没有触发倒计时，在%trap_duration%秒后转轮会自动爆炸。
description_en: Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%%.Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than %face_duration% seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after %trap_duration% seconds.

subject: ringmaster_dark_carnival_souvenirs
name_zh: 百戏大王·暗黑狂欢主持
description_zh: 只要百戏大王附近%souvenir_collection_range%范围内有敌方英雄阵亡，他就会随机获得一件可用一次的暗黑狂欢纪念品。额外的纪念品会以能量的形式存下。如果百戏大王没有纪念品，阵亡时会获得一件。
description_en: Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within %souvenir_collection_range% units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.

subject: ringmaster_funhouse_mirror
description_zh: 使用：比例失真制造英雄的%images_count%个不完美幻象，持续%illusion_duration%秒。幻象继承%tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%攻击力，承受%tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%%伤害。
description_en: Use: Proportion DistortionCreates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds. Your illusion deals %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%% and takes  %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.
notes_zh: 有%invuln_duration%秒的施法时间，其间处于无敌状态。

subject: ringmaster_strongman_tonic
description_zh: 使用：强力吸收暂时提升友方英雄的力量，数值为%strength_bonus_base% + %strength_bonus_per_level% * 百戏大王等级，持续%duration%秒。效果会维持%effect_strength_max_duration%秒然后在持续时间内不断减弱。
description_en: Use: Forcefully ImbibeTemporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by %strength_bonus_base% plus %strength_bonus_per_level% per Ringmaster's level for %duration% seconds. The effect holds for %effect_strength_max_duration% seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.

subject: ringmaster_whoopee_cushion
description_zh: 使用：噗把英雄向前推动%leap_distance%距离。在身后留下一团%fart_cloud_radius%范围的臭云，持续%fart_cloud_duration%秒，使敌人减速%fart_cloud_slow%%%。
description_en: Use: WhoopsiePropels your hero forward %leap_distance% units. Leaves a %fart_cloud_radius% radius stink cloud behind for %fart_cloud_duration% seconds that slows enemies by %fart_cloud_slow%%%.

subject: ringmaster_summon_unicycle
description_zh: 使用：上车召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续%mount_duration%秒。上车%damage_grace_period%秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过%damage_threshold%点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。
description_en: Use: Saddle UpSummons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for %mount_duration% seconds. %damage_grace_period%s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than %damage_threshold% dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.

subject: kez_echo_slash
description_zh: 凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击%katana_distance%距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的%tag_slow%%%减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。英雄会承受额外伤害。
description_en: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
notes_zh: 会摧毁树木。不会继承分裂效果。

subject: kez_grappling_claw
description_zh: 凯向目标单位或者树木发射一枚抓钩并摆荡过去。抓钩碰到目标后，该单位会被减速。凯到达敌方目标时，落地会发动一次攻击。
description_en: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.

subject: kez_kazurai_katana
description_zh: 长刀的攻击和技能会对敌人施加一个可叠加的持续伤害效果，持续时间内造成原攻击伤害一定百分比的额外伤害。凯可以主动使用技能，刺中目标，阻止他们移动或转身。目标身上的影武长刀效果爆发，使部分叠加数值立刻造成伤害。
description_en: Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time. Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.

shard.zh: 刺中后凯能从当次攻击吸血%lifesteal_pct%%%。如果从背后刺中目标，目标会被眩晕。提升最大爆发叠加数值。
shard.en: Kez lifesteals %lifesteal_pct%%% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.

subject: kez_switch_weapons
description_zh: 凯可以在影武长刀和翔影双钗之间变换。基于装备的武器，他会获得不同的攻击特性和技能。技能会一起升级，而且使用后，相对的武器技能也会进入冷却。凯切换到长刀后第一次长刀攻击或技能会造成额外伤害，切换到双钗后会获得额外移动速度。
description_en: Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.

scepter.zh: 在使用流派变换后%scepter_cooldown_timer%秒内施放的第一个技能不会使相对的武器技能进入冷却，或者已进入冷却的技能会结束冷却。施放任何武器的技能都会重置流派变换的冷却时间。
scepter.en: Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within %scepter_cooldown_timer% seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

subject: kez_raptor_dance
description_zh: 凯进入不可控制的状态，持续%AbilityCastPoint%秒，%invuln_period%秒为无敌状态并获得一次弱驱散效果。如果施法成功完成，凯会对周围发动致命的辐射状斩击，基于目标的最大生命值造成伤害，并且造成伤害的一定百分比会治疗凯。
description_en: Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
notes_zh: 斩击非英雄单位或幻象时吸血量减少至%illusion_lifesteal_pct%%%。

subject: kez_falcon_rush
description_zh: 开启后凯可以向敌方目标冲去，发动的攻击会重复一次。在这个状态下，凯拥有相位移动状态和减速抗性。
description_en: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
notes_zh: 不会对建筑生效。

subject: kez_talon_toss
description_zh: 凯向目标单位掷出一把钗，施加一次固定伤害的攻击，并造成沉默。
description_en: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
notes_zh: 固定伤害的攻击具有克敌机先效果。

subject: kez_shodo_sai
description_zh: 装备双钗时凯的攻击有几率对敌人造成致命一击。凯可以主动开启技能，使自身被缴械，面朝方向被锁定，招架来自目标方向的攻击和攻击效果，持续%parry_duration%秒。如果有敌方英雄的攻击被招架，该英雄会被眩晕%parry_stun_duration%秒并获得印记，拥有印记的目标被凯攻击时必定会造成致命一击，并且被眩晕。子技能可以用于提前取消招架状态。
description_en: Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark.  When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.

shard.zh: 招架会产生更强的印记，造成额外眩晕和致命一击伤害。
shard.en: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.

subject: kez_ravens_veil
description_zh: 凯释放出一阵迷烟，对附近敌方英雄施加标记，暂时削弱他们的视野。凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和隐身状态，直到他攻击或施法。
description_en: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.

subject: largo_catchy_lick
description_zh:
朗戈用他的舌头舔舐目标单位，把它拉回一小段距离，施加弱驱散，如果是敌人还会造成伤害。

击杀目标或驱散目标的效果后都会使朗戈暂时获得生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
description_en:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 可以舔舐神符，将其牵引。

subject: largo_frogstomp
description_zh: 朗戈把小青蛙扔到一片区域。他们每%stomp_interval%秒都会践踏地面，造成伤害和短暂眩晕并且区域内敌人的移动速度会被减缓。
description_en: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every %stomp_interval% second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.

subject: largo_croak_of_genius
description_zh:
朗戈对一名友方英雄弹奏一首小调。英雄的技能和物品拥有的魔法消耗降低，并且造成伤害后会回响，接下来%damage_duration%秒内再次造成原本伤害的一定百分比。

只要作用下的英雄消耗了魔法，本增益的剩余持续时间都会减少%duration_reduction%秒。朗戈身上的持续时间不会减少。
description_en:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following %damage_duration% seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by %duration_reduction%s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
notes_zh: 只适用于可受到技能增强作用的伤害来源。
只会在来源和目标相距%max_distance%以内时施加伤害。

subject: largo_encore
description_zh: 朗戈对自身或队友施加的增益效果会延长持续时间。
description_en: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.

shard.zh: 只要朗戈对友方英雄施加单位目标技能的增益效果，他也会获得该增益。只要朗戈对自身施加，该增益也会施加给指向性技能的施法距离内最近的友方英雄。
shard.en: Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff.If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.

subject: largo_amphibian_rhapsody
description_zh:
朗戈准备好弹奏乐曲。他被缴械，而他的技能栏切换为3个乐曲技能，每个都有不同的效果。乐曲只有弹在节拍上才会生效。

每次成功弹奏他都会获得一层律动的叠加效果。每层叠加效果都会对他提供额外护甲，并且降低每首乐曲的魔法消耗，但是他只要错过一次节拍就会失去一层叠加效果。叠加效果在朗戈的乐曲结束后还会粘滞一小段时间。
description_en:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
notes_zh: 这个模式下可以使用物品。

scepter.zh: 朗戈在每次节拍时可以弹奏两首乐曲。
scepter.en: Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.

subject: largo_song_fight_song
description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲对附近敌人造成%burst_damage%点魔法伤害。乐曲还会使附近友方英雄的技能增强提升，并且他们的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。
description_en: Largo plays a song that deals %burst_damage% magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.

scepter.zh: 这首乐曲用于两首共弹时每层律动都会额外造成%damage_per_stack%点魔法伤害。
scepter.en: Deals additional %damage_per_stack% magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.

subject: largo_song_double_time
description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会提升附近友方单位的移动速度，还有短时间的减速抗性。
description_en: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.

subject: largo_song_good_vibrations
description_zh: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会治疗附近友方英雄。
description_en: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.

subject: abyssal_blade

notes_en: Uses at most one charge per damage instance.

subject: invis_sword
description_en: Active: Shadow Walk Makes you invisible for %windwalk_duration% seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell.  While Shadow Walk is active, you move %windwalk_movement_speed%%% faster and can move through units.    If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain %windwalk_bonus_damage% bonus physical damage on that attack.
notes_en: Has a %windwalk_fade_time% second fade time.
If the invisibility ends without attacking, the bonus damage is lost.

subject: javelin
description_en: Passive: Pierce Grants each attack a %bonus_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus magical damage.

subject: lesser_crit
description_en: Passive: Critical Strike Grants each attack a %crit_chance%%% chance to deal %crit_multiplier%%% damage.
notes_en: Critical Strike does not work against buildings.

subject: lifesteal
description_en: Passive: Lifesteal Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

subject: lotus_orb
description_en: Active: Echo Shell Applies a shield to the target unit for %active_duration% seconds which re-casts most targeted spells back to their caster.  The shielded unit will still take damage from the spell. Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Echo Shell.

subject: maelstrom
description_en: Passive: Chain Lightning Grants a %chain_chance%%% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between %chain_strikes% targets within a %chain_radius% radius, dealing %chain_damage% magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.

subject: mage_slayer
description_en: Passive: Mage Slayer Places a debuff when you attack enemies, dealing %dps% physical damage per second and causing them to do %spell_amp_debuff%%% less spell damage for %duration% seconds.

subject: magic_stick
description_en: Active: Energy Charge  Instantly restores %restore_per_charge% health and mana per charge stored.   Max %max_charges% charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.
notes_en: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.

subject: magic_wand
description_en: Active: Energy Charge Instantly restores %restore_per_charge% health and mana per charge stored.   Max %max_charges% charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.
notes_en: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.

subject: manta
description_en: Active: Mirror Image Creates %images_count% images of your hero that last %illusion_duration% seconds.   Melee images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_melee%%% damage, while Ranged images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%. Illusions take %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.   Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
Many effects are removed upon using Manta.
Yasha based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.

subject: mask_of_madness
description_en: Active: Berserk Gives %berserk_bonus_attack_speed% attack speed, %berserk_bonus_movement_speed%%% / %berserk_bonus_movement_speed_melee%%% movement speed (ranged/melee), and %berserk_slow_resist%%%/%berserk_slow_resist_melee%%% slow resistance (ranged/melee), but reduces your armor by %berserk_armor_reduction% and silences you.  Lasts %berserk_duration% seconds.   Passive: Lifesteal Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

subject: mekansm
description_en: Active: Restore Restores %heal_amount% health to allied units in a %heal_radius% radius.   Passive: Mekansm Aura Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allied units in a %aura_radius% radius.
notes_en: Restore does not affect units that have been affected by Restore or Guardian Greaves Mend within Mekansm's cooldown.
Multiple instances of Mekansm Aura do not stack.

subject: meteor_hammer
description_en: Active: Meteor Hammer  CHANNELED - After a successful channel, summons a meteor that strikes a %impact_radius% AoE, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds and dealing impact damage. Continues to deal damage over time to enemies units and buildings for %burn_duration% seconds. Non-building units are also slowed for %burn_slow%%% for the duration of the burn.   Building Impact Damage: %impact_damage_buildings%  Building Over Time Damage: %burn_dps_buildings%   Non-Building Impact Damage: %impact_damage_units%  Non-Building Over Time Damage: %burn_dps_units%   Channel Duration: %max_duration% seconds. Landing Time: %land_time% seconds.

subject: mjollnir
description_en: Active: Static Charge Places a charged shield on a target unit for %static_duration% seconds which has a %static_chance%%% chance to release a %static_damage% magical damage shocking bolt at a nearby attacker and %static_strikes% additional enemies.   Passive: Chain Lightning Grants a %chain_chance%%% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between %chain_strikes% targets within a %chain_radius% radius, dealing %chain_damage% magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.
notes_en: Static Charge cannot trigger more than once per second.
Static Charge's shock deals magical damage centered on hero with the Static Charge. Static Charge's targets cannot be more than %static_seconary_radius% range away.
Static Charge procs will not bounce to heroes that are invisible or hidden by Fog of War.

subject: monkey_king_bar
description_en: Passive: Pierce Grants each attack a %bonus_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus magical damage.

subject: moon_shard
description_en: Use: Consume  Consume the Moon Shard to permanently gain %consumed_bonus% attack speed and %consumed_bonus_night_vision% bonus night vision. Max 1 use.   Passive: Shade Sight Grants bonus night vision.

subject: nullifier
description_en: Active: Nullify  Dispels the target and applies a debuff for %mute_duration% seconds. Continuously dispels and slows the target.  Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Can be cast on invulnerable units.

subject: octarine_core
description_en: Passive: Cooldown Reduction Reduces the cooldown time of all spells and items.

subject: orb_of_corrosion
description_en: Passive: Corrosion  Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor%, slows their movement by %slow_ranged%%% (%slow_melee%%% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by %heal_reduction%%%. Lasts for %duration% seconds.
notes_en: Armor reduction does not stack with its components, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.

subject: orb_of_frost
description_en: Passive: Frost Your attacks slow the target's movement by %slow_ranged%%% (%slow_melee%%% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by %heal_reduction%%%. Lasts for %duration% seconds.

subject: orb_of_venom
description_en: Passive: Poison Attack Poisons the target, dealing %damage% magical damage per second. Lasts for %poison_duration% seconds.
notes_en: Does not stack with its upgrades.

subject: orchid
description_en: Active: Soul Burn Silences the target unit for %silence_duration% seconds. At the end of the silence, %silence_damage_percent%%% of the damage received while silenced is inflicted as bonus magical damage.

subject: overwhelming_blink
description_en: Active: Overwhelming Blink  Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.  After teleportation, all enemies in a %radius% AoE take damage equal to %damage_base% + %damage_pct_instant%%% of your strength and an additional %damage_pct_over_time%%% over time, and have %movement_slow%%% movement speed slow and %attack_slow% attack speed slow for %duration% seconds.   Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes_en: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

subject: pavise
description_en: Active: Protect  When cast on an ally, grants them a physical damage barrier that absorbs %absorb_amount% damage. Duration: %duration%s.

subject: phase_boots
description_en: Active: Phase  Gives %phase_movement_speed%%% increased movement speed on melee heroes, and %phase_movement_speed_range%%% on ranged heroes, and lets you move through units and turn more quickly for %phase_duration% seconds. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

subject: phylactery
description_en: Passive: Empower Spell  The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% bonus damage to the target and slows them by %slow%%% for %slow_duration%s.

subject: pipe
description_en: Active: Barrier Gives a magic damage barrier that absorbs %barrier_block% damage to all nearby allies. Lasts %barrier_duration% seconds.  Radius: %barrier_radius%   Passive: Insight Aura  Gives allied units %magic_resistance_aura%%% magic resistance.  Radius: %aura_radius%
notes_en: Barrier does not affect units that have been affected by Barrier within Pipe of Insight's cooldown.
Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.

subject: power_treads
description_en: Active: Switch Attribute Switches between +%bonus_stat% Strength, +%bonus_stat% Agility, or +%bonus_stat% Intelligence. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes_en: Power Treads can be built using a Belt of Strength, Band of Elvenskin, or a Robe of the Magi.

subject: quelling_blade
description_en: Active: Chop Tree  Destroy a target tree.     Passive: Quell  Increases attack damage against non-hero units by %damage_bonus% for melee heroes, and %damage_bonus_ranged% for ranged.
notes_en: Effects of multiple quelling blades do not stack.

subject: radiance
description_en: Toggle: Burn  When active, scorches enemies for %aura_damage% magical damage per second. Illusions deal %aura_damage_illusions% magical damage per second.  Radius: %aura_radius%

subject: rapier
description_en: Toggle: Transmute  Toggle to gain either %bonus_spell_amp%%% bonus spell amplification or %bonus_damage% bonus attack damage.   Passive: Everlasting   Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.    Becomes unusable if picked up by an ally of its owner until it is returned to its owner. It is immediately usable by anybody if an enemy of the owner picks it up and is killed. A dropped Rapier cannot be picked up by a courier.
notes_en: If Divine Rapier is dropped and picked up by an enemy of its original owner, it cannot be dropped again except by death.
Spell Amplification from multiple Rapiers does not stack.

subject: refresher
description_en: Active: Reset Cooldowns Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Shard. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.

subject: refresher_shard
description_en: Use: Reset Cooldowns Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Orb. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.
notes_en: Refresher Shard is shareable.

subject: revenants_brooch
description_en: Passive: Phantom Critical Grants each attack a %crit_chance%%% chance to deal an additional %crit_multiplier%%% of the attack's damage as bonus magic damage.
notes_en: Counts as a Critical Strike for purposes of stacking with other sources of Critical Strike.
Phantom Critical does not work against buildings.

subject: ring_of_basilius
description_en: Passive: Basilius Aura Grants %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allies.    Radius: %aura_radius%

subject: rod_of_atos
description_en: Active: Cripple Roots the target for %duration% seconds.

subject: sange_and_yasha
notes_en: Yasha-based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.

subject: satanic
description_en: Active: Unholy Rage Increases Lifesteal percentage to %unholy_lifesteal_total_tooltip%%% for %unholy_duration% seconds.   Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel     Passive: Lifesteal Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

subject: shadow_amulet
description_en: Active: Fade Grants invisibility to you or a target allied hero for %fade_duration%s. Movement speed during the invisibility is reduced by %movement_speed_reduction%%%.
notes_en: Takes %fade_time%s of the %fade_duration%s for the hero to fully fade into invisibility.

subject: shawl
notes_en: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.

subject: sheepstick
description_en: Active: Hex Turns a target unit into a harmless critter for %sheep_duration% seconds. The target has a base movement speed of %sheep_movement_speed% and will be silenced, muted, and disarmed. Instantly destroys illusions.
notes_en: The target will have a base movement speed of %sheep_movement_speed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

subject: shivas_guard
description_en: Active: Arctic Blast  Emits a freezing wave that deals %blast_damage% magical damage to enemies and slows their movement by %blast_movement_speed%%% for %blast_debuff_duration% seconds.  Radius: %blast_radius%   Passive: Freezing Aura  Reduces the attack speed of all enemies by %aura_attack_speed%.   Radius: %aura_radius%
notes_en: The wave extends at a speed of %blast_speed% to a max size of %blast_radius%.
The Arctic Blast follows its caster.
Multiple instances of Freezing Aura do not stack.
AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.

subject: silver_edge
description_en: Active: Shadow Walk Makes you invisible for %windwalk_duration% seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell.  While invisible, you move %windwalk_movement_speed%%% faster and can move through units.    Attacking to end the invisibility will deal %windwalk_bonus_damage% bonus physical damage, disable their passive abilities for %backstab_duration% seconds, and cap their movement speed to %max_movement_speed%.

subject: skadi
description_en: Passive: Cold Attack  Attacks lower enemy movement by %cold_slow_melee%%% if they are melee and %cold_slow_ranged%%% if they are ranged. Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by %cold_attack_slow_melee%%% and Health Restoration by %restoration_reduction%%%. Lasts for %cold_duration% seconds.

subject: smoke_of_deceit
description_en: Use: Disguise  Turns the caster and all allied player-controlled targets in a %application_radius% radius invisible, and grants %bonus_movement_speed%%% bonus movement speed for %duration% seconds.    While the caster is still disguised, any allies that come within %secondary_application_radius% range of them will also get the buff applied to them. Each smoke can only be applied once to allies.   Attacking or moving within %visibility_radius% range of an enemy hero or tower, will break the invisibility.   Disguise grants invisibility that is immune to True Sight.   Smoke of Deceit is usable from the backpack and has no cooldown when swapped into the main inventory.

subject: solar_crest
description_en: Active: Shine When cast on an ally, grants them %target_armor% armor, %target_attack_speed% attack speed, %target_movement_speed%%% movement speed and a %absorb_amount% physical damage barrier.   Does not grant bonus armor, movement or attack speed if used on self.   Duration: %duration%
notes_en: Shares cooldown with Pavise.

subject: soul_ring
description_en: Active: Sacrifice  Consume %AbilityHealthCost% health to temporarily gain %mana_gain% mana.  Lasts %duration% seconds.  If the mana gained cannot fit in your mana pool, it creates a buffer of mana that will be used before your mana pool.
notes_en: If this mana is not used before the duration ends, the extra mana is lost.

subject: specialists_array
description_en: Passive: Splitshot Ranged attacks have a %proc_chance%%% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to %count% nearby enemies with %secondary_target_range_bonus% extra range and within a %secondary_target_angle% degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal %base_proc_dmg% + %proc_dmg_pct%%% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects. The primary attack deals %base_proc_dmg% + %proc_dmg_pct_primary_tooltip%%% damage of a normal attack.

subject: sphere
description_en: Passive: Spellblock Blocks most targeted spells once every %block_cooldown% seconds.   Active: Transfer Spellblock Temporarily removes Spellblock from the item's owner and transfers it to an allied unit for %block_cooldown% seconds.
notes_en: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Spellblock.

subject: spirit_vessel
description_en: Active: Soul Release  When used against enemies, it reduces health by %enemy_hp_drain%%% of current health per second, and reduces Health Restoration by %restoration_reduction_enemy%%%. Deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second.   When used on allies, it provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration per second.   Lasts %duration% seconds.  Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units or the user dies.
notes_en: Empty vessels gain 2 charges.
Only the closest Spirit Vessel to the dying hero will gain a charge.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

subject: swift_blink
description_en: Active: Swift Blink  Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.  After teleportation, you gain %bonus_movement%%% phased movement speed and +%bonus_agi_active% Agility for %duration% seconds.   Swift Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes_en: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

subject: talisman_of_evasion
notes_en: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

subject: tango
description_en: Use: Devour  Consumes a target tree to gain %health_regen% health regeneration for %buff_duration% seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.  Comes with %tooltip_charges% charges.  Can be used on an allied hero to give them one Tango.  Tree Range: %abilitycastrange%
notes_en: Heals for double duration when used on a Ironwood Tree or Wards.

subject: tango_single
description_en: Use: Devour  Consumes a target tree to gain %health_regen% health regeneration for %buff_duration% seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.  Tree Range: %abilitycastrange%
notes_en: Heals for double duration when used on a Ironwood Tree or Wards.

subject: tidehunter_fish
description_en: Yummy Fish

subject: tpscroll
description_en: Use: Teleport After channeling for %tooltip_channel_time% seconds, teleports you to a target friendly building.   Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
notes_en: If multiple heroes teleport to the same location in succession, the channeling time will be increased for each successive hero.
Teleport can be prevented or canceled by Root abilities.

subject: tranquil_boots
description_en: Passive: Break  Whenever you attack a hero or are attacked by any unit, the bonus %bonus_health_regen% HP regen is lost and the movement speed bonus is reduced to %broken_movement_speed% for %break_time% seconds. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

subject: travel_boots
description_en: Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units, reduces cooldown and does not consume a charge on usage.  Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes_en: Movement speed bonuses from boots do not stack.

subject: travel_boots_2
description_en: Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units and heroes, reduces cooldown, channel time and does not consume a charge on usage.  Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes_en: Movement speed bonuses from boots do not stack.

subject: ultimate_scepter
description_en: Passive: Ability Upgrade Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.

subject: ultimate_scepter_2
description_en: Passive: Ability Upgrade Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.

subject: ultimate_scepter_roshan
name_zh: 阿哈利姆福佑 - 肉山
description_en: Passive: Ability Upgrade Upgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.

subject: urn_of_shadows
description_en: Active: Soul Release  Provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration when cast on allies, and deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second when cast on enemies.  Lasts %duration% seconds.  Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units.
notes_en: Empty urns gain 2 charges.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

subject: vanguard
description_en: Passive: Damage Block  Grants a %block_chance%%% chance to block %block_damage_melee% damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and %block_damage_ranged% damage on ranged.
notes_en: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.

subject: veil_of_discord
description_en: Active: Spell Weakness  Cast a %debuff_radius% radius blast that causes enemy heroes to take %spell_amp%%% increased damage from spells.  Can be cast while channeling.  Duration: %resist_debuff_duration% seconds.
notes_en: Spell Weakness does not stack with Bloodstone's Spell Weakness Aura.

subject: vladmir
description_en: Passive: Vladmir's Aura Grants %lifesteal_aura%%% lifesteal, %damage_aura%%% bonus damage, %mana_regen_aura% mana regeneration, and %armor_aura% armor to nearby allies.  Radius: %aura_radius%
notes_en: Lifesteal on attacks against creeps is reduced to %lifesteal_creeps_tooltip%%%.

subject: voodoo_mask
description_en: Passive: Spell Lifesteal Heals the wearer for a percentage of spell damage dealt to enemies.
notes_en: Does not heal from Pure or Reflected damage.

subject: ward_dispenser
description_en: Use: Plant  Plant the currently active ward.  Double-Click to switch the currently active ward.
notes_en: Hold Control to give one ward to an allied hero.

subject: ward_observer
description_en: Use: Plant Plants an Observer Ward, an invisible watcher that gives ground vision in a %vision_range_tooltip% radius to your team. Lasts %duration_minutes_tooltip% minutes.  Hold Control to give one Observer Ward to an allied hero.

subject: ward_sentry
description_en: Use: Plant  Plants a Sentry Ward, an invisible watcher that grants True Sight, the ability to see invisible enemy units and wards, to any existing allied vision within a %true_sight_range% radius. Lasts %duration_minutes_tooltip% minutes.  Does not grant ground vision. Hold Control to give one Sentry Ward to an allied hero.

subject: wind_lace
description_en: Bonuses from multiple Wind Laces do not stack.
notes_en: Multiple instances do not stack.

subject: wind_waker
description_en: Active: Cyclone  Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can be cast on yourself, enemy units or allied units. When cast on yourself, you can move the tornado at a speed of %tornado_speed%.  Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing. Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
When cast on yourself, the cyclone can be moved anywhere at a speed of 360.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.

subject: witch_blade
description_en: Passive: Witch Blade Causes your next attack to apply a poison for %slow_duration% seconds, slowing by %slow%%% and dealing %int_damage_multiplier%x your intelligence as damage every second. This attack has True Strike.

subject: yasha
notes_en: Yasha-based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.
